data.title: Senior Project Manager (m/w/d) / Print, Digital & Bewegtbild
Ärztin / Arzt in Weiterbildung für Allgemeinmedizin (m/w/d)
data.description:
IHR START BEI PRAXISEINS

Sie suchen eine strukturierte Weiterbildung mit persönlichem Mentoring, tiefgehenden Patientenbeziehungen und der ganzen Breite der Allgemeinmedizin zu geregelten Arbeitszeiten? Bei PraxisEins ist das möglich.

Bei uns absolvieren Sie Ihre Weiterbildung zum Facharzt für Allgemeinmedizin (m/w/d) in einem professionellen, kollegialen und zukunftsorientierten Umfeld. Sie arbeiten patientennah in modernen Hausarztzentren und werden dabei strukturiert und individuell begleitet.

WAS WIR IHNEN BIETEN

  • Weiterbildung auf höchstem Niveau: Strukturierte Einarbeitung & persönliches Mentoring mit voller Weiterbildungsbefugnis

  • Attraktive Vergütung und Entwicklungsperspektiven: Sie erhalten ein attraktives Gehalt - bei sehr guter Leistung bietet sich in unserer Gruppe nach der Weiterbildungszeit die Möglichkeit des Einstiegs als Facharzt mit perspektivischem Aufstieg zur ärztlichen Leitung

  • Vereinbarkeit mit der Familie: Keine Pflicht-Dienste und 35 Tage Urlaub (inkl. Fortbildungstagen) - zudem bestehen Möglichkeiten für Teilzeitmodelle

  • Qualitätsmedizin: Unsere Standorte verfügen über modernste Diagnostik und digitalisierte Praxisabläufe; ein wertschätzender & kollegialer Austausch ist uns wichtig

  • Digitale Unterstützung: effiziente Prozesse, moderne Praxissoftware & zeitgemäße Technologien wie Telemedizin erleichtern Ihnen den Alltag und erlauben den vollen Fokus auf die Medizin

IHRE AUFGABEN

  • Ambulante hausärztliche Versorgung eines breiten Patientenspektrums im Rahmen einer strukturierten Weiterbildung

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Fachärzten für Allgemeinmedizin

  • Aktive Mitwirkung an Diagnostik, Therapie und Prävention

  • Teilnahme an internen Fortbildungen und Fallbesprechungen

IHR PROFIL

  • Mindestens ein Jahr klinische Erfahrung, idealerweise in der Inneren Medizin oder Allgemeinmedizin

  • Interesse an einer langfristigen Tätigkeit in der hausärztlichen Versorgung

  • Freude an patientenzentrierter Medizin und Teamarbeit

  • Strukturierte, verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Über PraxisEins

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

Unsere Mission

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen – mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet.

data.title: Cryogenics Engineer – Test Facility & Auxiliary Cryoplants
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

You will deliver the helium refrigerator and cryogenic distribution for Proxima's Alpha coil test facility, taking these systems from requirements and process design through procurement, installation and commissioning. You will also support the engineering of the refrigerator for the cryopumps of the neutral beam injectors and divertor, and act as the process and safety owner for these systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the cryogenic supply infrastructure for the Alpha coil test facility, covering the main refrigerator, liquid nitrogen equipment, cryogenic distribution and interconnecting valve box, from concept to commissioning and test operation

  • Define requirements, process flow diagrams and P&IDs for cryogenic refrigerators and ancillary systems such as helium storage tanks, LHe dewars, purification and gas recovery

  • Size lines, valves and pressure relief devices based on your relief case definitions, in line with PED and relevant EN/ISO standards

  • Write specifications and RFQ packages, evaluate offers, and act as expert customer for suppliers through design reviews, FAT, installation and site acceptance

  • Plan and lead installation and commissioning, write operating procedures, and support operation on site close to Munich

WHO YOU ARE

  • A team player who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes

  • A proven track record of designing, building and commissioning cryogenic or similar gas systems in industrial plants, test facilities, accelerators, or space infrastructure

  • Hands-on experience developing P&IDs, sizing pressure relief devices to recognised standards (e.g. ISO 21013, ISO 4126), and using process or system simulation tools such as EcosimPro or Aspen HYSYS for helium refrigeration plants or similar

  • Experience with pressure equipment design to EN 13445 or AD 2000, and with CAD

  • Proficiency with programming languages used in science and engineering (particularly Python) is highly beneficial but not essential

  • Demonstrated ability to manage the delivery of complex systems with external suppliers to schedule and budget

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

This role sits at L2/L3/L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information

Build and lead the team owning the architecture, design, and integration of the facility-wide monitoring and control systems for Alpha, Proxima’s net energy gain stellarator. We are moving away from legacy industrial control paradigms towards a fully integrated control and observability platform. We are looking for a leader inspired by the cutting edge of robotics, autonomous vehicles, and modern aerospace avionics to lead this development. Pushing forwards the cutting edge of control, data, and monitoring capabilities for energy infrastructure, your role will span physical infrastructure, systems programming, real-time operations and scalable facility compute.

  • Specify mission control & supervisory software: Own the overarching supervisory control, telemetry pipelines, and live monitoring stack across Alpha and future Proxima facilities.

  • Drive functional safety strategy: Define the device-wide technical strategy for functional safety, collaborating directly with internal engineers and external regulatory stakeholders.

  • Lead physical facility & environmental integration: Partner with facility teams to ensure physical services, cabling, and infrastructure support the I&C architecture under harsh radiation and magnetic field constraints.

  • Drive hardware R&D: Identify R&D opportunities for control and automation hardware. Act as an expert customer to specify and co-design with external vendors.

  • A vision for modern control and data systems: Strong background working with safety and mission-critical software, combined with a vision to incorporate the best of modern software and AI into operational infrastructure.

  • Lessons learnt in high-consequence engineering: Proven experience in high-performance sectors operating under strict performance and reliability constraints. Demonstrated track record in critical external customer, vendor, and stakeholder management.

  • Operational and physical integration experience: You bring hands-on operational skills in mission control and real-time data analysis, combined with experience integrating software with physical hardware.

data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build, assemble and modify prototypes, experimental hardware, custom tooling and development rigs for engineering and special projects across the programme.

  • Turn engineering drawings, models, and sketches into practical hardware. Clarify missing requirements and agree the build approach with the responsible engineer before committing to uncertain or irreversible steps.

  • Fabricate and adapt components using fitting, cutting, drilling, soldering, bonding and assembly techniques within your competence. Coordinate specialist machining, welding or other work when needed.

  • Identify buildability issues early, including tolerance stacks, inaccessible fasteners, component fit and assembly sequence, and provide practical feedback to the design team.

  • Prepare and run development trials, including winding, joining, insulation and impregnation trials as assigned. Install instrumentation, commission rigs with engineers, take measurements and record what changed and what happened.

  • Investigate unexpected behaviour, propose practical fixes and work through build-test-modify iterations with engineers.

  • Organise the practical delivery of assigned projects: source small parts and consumables through agreed purchasing routes, arrange tools and build activities, and keep the workshop ready for use. Communicate progress, blockers and changing priorities to the lead technician.

  • Keep clear as-built records, annotated drawings, photographs, settings and trial observations so another technician can reproduce the work and understand each modification.

  • Transfer proven prototypes and methods to manufacturing or routine testing through initial work instructions, tooling, assembly sequences, training and technical handovers.

  • Work with engineers to identify hazards and establish the necessary risk assessments and controls before starting work on unproven hardware.

     

WHO YOU ARE

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronic or related engineering work, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Hands-on experience building, modifying and troubleshooting mechanical or electromechanical hardware in a workshop, laboratory, development or advanced manufacturing environment.

  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and 3D models, with working familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and practical measurement skills.

  • Confident hand-tool and workshop skills, sound fabrication and assembly judgement, and a willingness to develop unfamiliar techniques.

  • Resourcefulness with incomplete information: you investigate, ask useful questions, find suitable parts and propose a practical next step while keeping the engineering objective clear.

  • Sound judgement about technical uncertainty, safety and when a build or design change requires engineering review before proceeding.

  • The ability to organise work, adapt to agreed priority changes and document configurations and findings clearly.

  • Working English for technical discussions, drawings, instructions and build records.

Nice to have

  • Specialist fabrication skills such as manual or CNC machining, sheet-metal work, welding, brazing or additive manufacturing.

  • Experience creating or modifying simple parts and fixtures in CATIA, SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or similar CAD tools.

  • Experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition, electrical wiring, vacuum, cryogenics or superconducting hardware.

  • Experience with composites, resins, vacuum bagging, insulation or impregnation.

  • Experience taking first-of-a-kind hardware or a prototype process through to repeatable manufacturing and technical handover.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

 

This job would require frequent travels to our office in Villigen ( Zurich, CH)

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Maintain, troubleshoot and repair machinery across our magnet factory,keeping equipment safe, accurate and available.

  • Carry out preventive maintenance, inspections and repairs on mechanical, electromechanical and pneumatic systems.

  • Identify wear early, flag long-lead items and communicate to the lead technician.

  • Record failure modes, downtime, repairs, parts used and equipment modifications.

  • Apply lockout/tagout, safe isolation, stored-energy controls and controlled restart procedures.

  • Provide clear handovers on equipment condition, outstanding faults and any operating restrictions.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in industrial maintenance, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing production or process equipment.

  • Strong electrical and mechanical diagnostic skills.

  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, equipment manuals and electrical or pneumatic schematics, and practical familiarity with mechanisms, pneumatics, drives and sensors.

  • Confidence using workshop tools and measuring equipment to strip, rebuild, align and inspect machine components accurately.

  • A disciplined approach to electrical and machine safety, safe isolation and stored energy, with sound judgement about when specialist support is required.

  • The ability to organise assigned work independently, keep reliable records and adapt as equipment and processes develop.

  • Working English for understanding technical instructions, recording work and communicating with technicians, engineers and suppliers.

Nice to have

  • Experience diagnosing programmable logic controller (PLC) systems beyond the operator screen, including Beckhoff/TwinCAT or comparable controls.

  • Experience with reel-to-reel machinery, tension control, precision motion, or cable and conductor handling.

  • Experience commissioning custom machinery, a new cell or a new production line, including factory or site acceptance testing.

  • Hydraulic, vacuum, cryogenic or high-voltage equipment experience; an electrical qualification such as Elektrofachkraft.

  • Experience with computerised maintenance management systems (CMMS), establishing preventive-maintenance programmes or structured reliability improvement.

  • German language skills.

  • Experience introducing new products or processes, supporting pilot builds or transferring development work into production.

  • Familiarity with structured problem solving, such as Lean/Six Sigma improvement methods.

data.title: Production Technician
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Maintain, troubleshoot and repair machinery across our magnet factory,keeping equipment safe, accurate and available.

  • Carry out preventive maintenance, inspections and repairs on mechanical, electromechanical and pneumatic systems.

  • Diagnose breakdowns, intermittent faults and undocumented failures. Resolve the root cause and verify safe operation before returning equipment to service.

  • Assemble, install, align, and commission new equipment.

  • Support factory and site acceptance tests, installation checks.

  • Work with multiple teams to distinguish machine faults from setup, material, process or measurement problems.

  • Work with controls and manufacturing engineering to tune equipment, including winding tension, motion, vacuum and thermal profiles, within approved process limits.

  • Identify wear early, flag long-lead items and communicate to the lead technician.

  • Record failure modes, downtime, repairs, parts used and equipment modifications.

  • Apply lockout/tagout, safe isolation, stored-energy controls and controlled restart procedures.

  • Provide clear handovers on equipment condition, outstanding faults and any operating restrictions.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in industrial maintenance, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing production or process equipment.

  • Strong electrical and mechanical diagnostic skills.

  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, equipment manuals and electrical or pneumatic schematics, and practical familiarity with mechanisms, pneumatics, drives and sensors.

  • Confidence using workshop tools and measuring equipment to strip, rebuild, align and inspect machine components accurately.

  • A disciplined approach to electrical and machine safety, safe isolation and stored energy, with sound judgement about when specialist support is required.

  • The ability to organise assigned work independently, keep reliable records and adapt as equipment and processes develop.

  • Working English for understanding technical instructions, recording work and communicating with technicians, engineers and suppliers.

Nice to have

  • Experience with reel-to-reel machinery, tension control, precision motion, or cable and conductor handling.

  • Experience diagnosing programmable logic controller (PLC) systems beyond the operator screen, including Beckhoff/TwinCAT or comparable controls.

  • Experience commissioning custom machinery, a new cell or a new production line, including factory or site acceptance testing.

  • Hydraulic, vacuum, cryogenic or high-voltage equipment experience; an electrical qualification such as Elektrofachkraft.

  • Experience with computerised maintenance management systems (CMMS), establishing preventive-maintenance programmes or structured reliability improvement.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

data.title: Social Media & E-Mail Marketing Manager (m/w/d) – Fokus Klettern & Bouldern
data.description:
Über uns

Hinter der FT Fitness Technology GmbH stehen zwei Marken: PULLUP & DIP für Fitness-Equipment und CLEVO: Climbing Evolution für Kletterprodukte für Zuhause. Unser Anspruch: verlässliche Lösungen zu entwickeln, die Grenzen überwinden. Wir entwickeln selbst, verkaufen über unseren eigenen Webshop, Amazon und weitere Marktplätze und versenden weltweit.

Für CLEVO suchen wir jemanden, der Klettern nicht nur vermarktet, sondern lebt. Du wirst das Gesicht und die Stimme unserer Klettermarke und unterstützt zusätzlich PULLUP & DIP im E-Mail Marketing und auf Social Media.

Deine Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du die Social-Media-Kanäle und das E-Mail-Marketing mit klarem Fokus auf Klettern und Bouldern.

  • Content Creation für CLEVO: Du entwickelst Konzepte, schreibst Skripte für Reels, Ads und organischen Content und planst Shootings von der Idee bis zur Shotlist.

  • Markenbotschafter*in: Du repräsentierst CLEVO auf unseren Kanälen, vor allem mit Educational Content zu Technik, Training und Verletzungsprävention und mit Videos, in denen du unsere Produkte in Aktion zeigst.

  • Social Media Management: Du postest Content, erkennst Trends, bevor sie Mainstream sind, und baust aktiv unsere Community auf. Kommentare und DMs beantwortest du so, dass man merkt: Hier redet jemand, der weiß, wovon er spricht.

  • E-Mail Marketing: Du setzt Kampagnen in Klaviyo operativ um, segmentierst Zielgruppen und sorgst für eine kundenspezifische Ansprache, für CLEVO und PULLUP & DIP.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Grafikdesign- und Content-Creation-Team zusammen und berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Marketing.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du kletterst oder boulderst selbst aktiv und brennst für den Sport.

  • Idealerweise kennst du dich in der kletterspezifischen Trainingslehre aus, zum Beispiel mit Fingerkraft, Hangboard-Training oder Periodisierung.

  • Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media Content und verfolgst, was in der Medienlandschaft passiert.

  • Du bist selbst auf Social Media aktiv. Ein eigener Kanal rund ums Klettern oder erste Erfahrung vor der Kamera sind ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit CRM und E-Mail Marketing, idealerweise mit Klaviyo.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, sicher und mit Freude, ob mit Kund*innen, in der Community oder im Team.

  • Berufseinsteiger*in, Quereinsteiger*in oder erfahrener Marketerin: Bei uns zählen Leidenschaft, Lernbereitschaft und Persönlichkeit mehr als der perfekte Lebenslauf.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Dynamisches Umfeld: Ein spannender Job in einem innovativen, wachsenden Unternehmen mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Teamspirit: Ein motiviertes, freundliches Team, flache Hierarchien und eine kollegiale Atmosphäre, in der alle an einem Strang ziehen.

  • Teamevents: Office-Partys, Eisstockschießen, Escape Room, Oktoberfest und mehr.

  • Office mit Lage: Modernes, helles Büro in München, nahe der S-Bahn Hirschgarten. Die Kletterhalle Einstein ist um die Ecke, der Feierabend-Boulder-Session steht also nichts im Weg.

  • Flexibel: Hybrides Arbeiten mit einem Tag Home Office pro Woche.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unsere Produkte und weitere Benefits.

  • Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket

  • Fitness: Wellpass für Sport und Wellness


Klingt nach dir?
Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf mit einem Motivationsschreiben, in dem du dich einmal kurz vorstellen kannst. Wenn du eigenen Content erstellst, freuen wir uns über die Links zu deinen Profilen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Our People Team is searching for a People Operations Specialist. You will play a pivotal role in keeping the employee lifecycle running smoothly across Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. You make sure contracts, payroll and employee data are right, and you are a go-to person for managers and employees on everyday HR questions. Reporting to the Head of People Ops, you will join a team that supports 325+ Mossers across 6 offices.

Your responsibilities

  • Core people operations: Own the employee lifecycle end to end, from onboarding and offboarding. Create and maintain employment contracts, amendments and templates for our locations in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, and manage employees hired through Employer of Record (EoR) partners. data.title: Senior Sofware Engineer, Operational Excellence
data.description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Incidents interrupt operations, drain team productivity, and erode user trust. As a member of the Operational Excellence team, you will help GetYourGuide notice problems sooner, fix them faster, and stop the same ones from coming back, so our travelers and suppliers see fewer disruptions and trust us more.

As we push boldly into AI-powered experiences, we don’t ignore the risks that increased output velocity creates. Faster change means more places for silent failures to hide. You will help our engineering organisation move fast with confidence, with the safeguards (tests, safe rollouts, monitoring, clear ownership) that catch problems before customers do.

Observability and cost efficiency are part of the same job: teams can’t fix or own what they can’t see. You will build the tooling, standards, and habits that make operational excellence a shared standard across all engineering teams, from blameless learning after every incident to alerts teams trust and cost visibility per team.

Your mission

You will act as an "engineer for the engineers" — partnering with other engineering teams to raise the bar on reliability, speed, and confidence in their systems.

Incident management & reliability

  • Drive down how often incidents happen, how long it takes us to notice them, and how long it takes to fix them, with a focus on catching problems with monitors instead of by chance

  • Lead post-incident reviews, translate learnings into systemic improvements, and make sure follow-up actions actually get done

  • Build tooling and runbooks that enable teams to detect, diagnose and resolve production issues faster

  • Champion a culture of blameless incident handling and continuous improvement

Observability & production confidence

  • Advance our Datadog-based observability practice — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting

  • Help teams set measurable reliability targets with actionable alerts that reach the right owner — not alert fatigue

  • Enable production debugging capabilities so engineers can triage issues without needing a specialist

Change confidence & release quality

  • Reduce how often changes cause failures in production by helping teams find and close the biggest gaps in their automated testing

  • Make testing and CI faster and more reliable for product teams, so engineers trust their tests instead of working around them

  • Identify blast radius risks and architectural gaps in evolving systems, and drive mitigation

  • Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices

Platform enablement

  • Design and maintain paved paths: well - documented golden paths for development, observability, testing, and incident response so engineering teams can do the right things by default

  • Work hands-on with product teams using Java and React to help them improve system design, testability, and operational hygiene

  • Draw on Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh expertise to guide product teams on infrastructure best practices

  • Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities

  • Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience

  • Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective

  • Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale

  • Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams

  • Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy)

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and container technology

  • Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, as well as CI/CD and build systems

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work

  • You work well across teams and raise standards through partnership

  • Communicates in clear, concise English: you listen to understand, adapt to your audience, and make sure people know what to do next

  • Positive, proactive team player who is passionate about operational excellence and who helps others deliver

What sets you apart

  • You have led improvements that reached many teams at once, not just your own, with results you can point to

  • You have helped teams ship with more confidence and fewer production surprises

  • You have embedded operational excellence practices into the culture of product engineering teams, not just platform teams

  • You have helped teams cut or avoid cost through technical or operational improvements

  • You have driven AI adoption beyond yourself: workflows you built are relied on by others and visibly changed how they work

How to apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘our culture’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

data.description:
We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join the Practice Efficiency team at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to define and deliver how AI transforms the daily work of healthcare professionals — through intelligent scheduling, automated document processing, smart task management, and AI-assisted patient communication. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will own the deepest technical challenges within the Practice Efficiency scope: setting the AI architecture bar, driving rigorous evaluation standards, and directly shaping how AI-powered features reach healthcare professionals and their patients at scale — starting with the Phone Assistant, currently one of Doctolib's most strategic product bets.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own end-to-end AI architecture decisions for Practice Efficiency — from model selection and agentic system design to production deployment patterns,, and strategic build vs. buy calls

  • Architect and deliver agentic applications at scale, defining how Practice Efficiency AI features are structured, evaluated, and iterated on in production

  • Design robust, scalable AI infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimisation, and observability — enabling the team to ship reliably and fast

  • Lead the technical delivery of the Phone Assistant's AI capabilities, balancing ambitious product ambitions with engineering rigour and production reliability

  • Ensure responsible AI delivery in a regulated healthcare context, embedding explainability, GDPR/HDS compliance, and human-in-the-loop design across all Practice Efficiency AI features

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into sound technical decisions, acting as a bridge between engineering depth and product delivery

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on building AI products — including experience building AI systems before the rise of large language models, giving you strong fundamentals in evaluation, data pipelines, and system design under uncertainty

  • Have a strong background in building and operating large-scale distributed systems — we value deep systems engineering expertise and will consider profiles who bring exceptional scale experience alongside a solid grounding in AI

  • Have hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic applications, with a clear understanding of the challenges around reliability, observability, and evaluation in production agentic systems

  • Are product-centric by nature: you have worked closely with Product Managers and product organisations, bring genuine business sense and customer closeness, and see yourself as part of the product delivery chain — not just the technical one

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, or automatic speech recognition in production environments

  • Have built AI products in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated domain where safety and auditability are non-negotiable

  • Have contributed to or built shared AI platforms used by multiple product teams

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack in this product area is Ruby on Rails and TypeScript/React in the monolith, Kotlin for new services, with Postgres, Redis and Kafka underneath.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

  • Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design Interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • Engineering Manager Case

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Kotlin

  • Full-time

  • Location: Berlin

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Im Technical Services arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserer Doctolib-Plattform und der deutschen Healthcare-IT-Landschaft. Du löst komplexe Integrationsprobleme, unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei technischen Herausforderungen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass Doctolib reibungslos in die Infrastruktur unserer Kund:innen integriert ist.

Du musst nicht vom ersten Tag an alles wissen. Mit Deinen fundierten Grundlagen und Deiner Motivation, unterstützen wir Dich, Dich in Themen wie die Telematikinfrastruktur und API/Konnektoren, einzuarbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben 

Du bist technische Ansprechperson rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur – von der Schnittstellen-Architektur über Kartenverwaltung bis hin zu Gematik-Standards. Kein Tag ist wie der andere.

  • Produkte, die laufen: Du supportest Doctolib-Lösungen rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur. und sorgst dafür, dass sie korrekt konfiguriert sind – und wenn doch mal etwas hakt, findest du heraus, warum.

  • Komplexe Probleme, echte Lösungen: Interoperabilitätsprobleme mit Konnektoren und APIs gehören zu deinem Alltag – du arbeitest eng mit IT-Service-Partnern zusammen und bringst auch schwierige Fälle zum Abschluss.

  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Buzzword: Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv, um schneller zu Lösungen zu kommen und Dir fundiertes Wissen aufzubauen – effizient und zielgerichtet.

  • Wissen, das bleibt: Du teilst dein Know-how proaktiv mit internen Teams, damit Probleme gar nicht erst entstehen und unsere Kund:innen das bestmögliche Erlebnis haben.

Dein Profil

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • API-Integration und Troubleshooting sind für dich kein Neuland – du hast echte Erfahrung damit, Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen.

  • Du kennst dich mit komplexen IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerken und sicherheitskritischen Systemen aus – und weißt, worauf es in solchen Umgebungen ankommt.

  • Erfahrung mit Observability-Tools wie Kibana, Datadog oder Elasticsearch.

  • Ein Abschluss in Informatik, Medizinischer Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Berufserfahrung ist willkommen – aber kein Pflichtfeld.

Was wir Dir bieten

StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland fit für KI zu machen und so die Daten- und KI-Kompetenzlücke im Land zu schließen.

Du steigst als zentrale IT-Ansprechperson für Deutschland bei uns ein, mit Sitz in Berlin und Verantwortung für die Standorte Berlin, München und Düsseldorf sowie für Kolleg:innen im Remote-Setup in der DACH-Region. Du berichtest an die globale IT-Leitung in Großbritannien, arbeitest eng mit dem UK-basierten Enterprise-Technology-Team zusammen und verantwortest den IT-Alltag in Deutschland mit hoher Eigenständigkeit. Dazu gehört die technische Integration von StackFuel in die IT-Landschaft von Multiverse.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist die lokale IT-Ansprechperson in Deutschland und bietest schnellen, verlässlichen Support auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du sorgst für ein stabiles, nutzerfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld im Büro (AV, WLAN, Meetingräume) in Berlin, München und Düsseldorf.

  • Du verantwortest den Joiner-Mover-Leaver-Prozess (JML) und den Hardware-Lifecycle von Anfang bis Ende: Beschaffung, Imaging, Rollout, Reparaturen und Asset-Management.

  • Du administrierst Endgeräte (macOS, Windows) und Identitäten systemübergreifend, u. a. in JumpCloud/Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, Slack und weiteren SaaS-Tools.

  • Du unterstützt lokale IT- und Sicherheitsprüfungen nach ISO 27001 und Cyber Essentials Plus und stellst sicher, dass Prozesse DSGVO-konform sind.

  • Du identifizierst und implementierst Automatisierungen (z. B. mit n8n oder Skripten), die manuelle und fehleranfällige Prozesse ersetzen.

  • Du setzt IT- und Sicherheitskontrollen um und dokumentierst sie.

  • Du begleitest die technische Integration von StackFuel in die bestehende IT-Landschaft von Multiverse und übernimmst dabei auch anspruchsvollere, standortübergreifende Projekte mit strategischer Bedeutung für die weitere Verzahnung der beiden Geografien.

  • Du unterstützt IT-Service-Management-Prozesse und deren Dokumentation (z. B. nach ITIL-Prinzipien).

  • Du wirkst an internen IT-Projekten mit anderen Teams mit (z. B. Rollouts, Tool-Einführungen und Security-Initiativen).

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem globalen Enterprise-Technology-Team zusammen, hältst globale Standards ein und entwickelst sie mit weiter.

  • Du stimmst Dich mit HR (JML), Office Management, Fachabteilungen, den Verantwortlichen für Compliance, Datenschutz und Sicherheit sowie bei Bedarf mit externen Dienstleistern ab.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im IT-Support oder in der Systemadministration, idealerweise als alleinige oder leitende IT-Ansprechperson für ein Büro oder einer Business Unit.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Endpoint-Management (macOS und Windows), Identity and Access Management (IAM) und SaaS-Administration.

  • Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik (WLAN, LAN, Routing, Firewalls).

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit:

    • Google Workspace

    • Entra, optional Okta

    • Mac-Flottenmanagement (z. B. Iru, Jamf)

    • IT-Service-Management (z. B. ITIL) und IT-Asset-Management

    • ISO-27001-Umgebungen

Technische Kompetenz

data.title: IT Working Student
data.description:
Compliance is what stands between a European company and its next enterprise deal. Kertos clears it. Information security, data protection, and AI management run in one system covering ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2, the EU AI Act, and more, with certified experts on the project from start to finish.

 

KAIA, our AI assistant, drafts the policies, checks the evidence, and monitors the controls, eliminating roughly 80% of manual work.

 

400+ customers, including Personio, Enpal, Flink, and Blacklane use Kertos. Every audit with us has been successful. A powerhouse of 75+ people in Munich and Berlin and a €14M Series A behind us. We are hiring for what comes next!

Your purpose at Kertos

You’ll be an essential part of our internal IT team and ensure that everyone at Kertos can work smoothly. Our team is growing rapidly, new employees, new tools, new devices and you’ll keep everything organized. You’ll be the first point of contact when something isn’t working, and you’ll actively help ensure that our IT infrastructure scales with us. If you’re interested in cybersecurity, you’ll also have the opportunity to learn about topics like MDM and endpoint security and take on responsibility in those areas.

  • Internal IT Support: You’ll handle requests from the team, from software issues to laptop-related problems, and ensure that no one has to wait long for a solution.

  • Software Access & Accounts: You’ll manage tool access, create new accounts, and properly remove them during offboarding.

  • IT Administration: You’ll keep our IT processes organized and well-documented, so we can maintain a clear overview even as we continue to grow.

The skills, motivation, and mentality you should bring

 

  • You’re available for a long-term position as a working student and can commit to 15–20 hours per week with us.

  • You’re familiar with common operating systems, software installations, and basic networking technology.

  • You can independently prioritize multiple concurrent requests, remain reliable, and find pragmatic solutions.

  • You have an affinity for startups, enjoy pitching in, and communicate openly; German language skills are a plus, but not required.

  • You’re interested in cybersecurity and would like to learn about topics such as MDM configuration or endpoint security (e.g., CrowdStrike).

  • You have already worked with ticketing systems, MDM solutions, or similar IT tools.

  • You’re curious about how a fast-growing team functions internally and are eager to actively help shape its structures.

 

Why Kertos

 

  • Steep Learning Curve: With us, you’ll have full responsibility from day one, drive projects forward independently, and learn a great deal in the process

  • Regular feedback: We foster an open feedback culture with regular 1-on-1s and 360-degree feedback cycles

  • Full flexibility: Whether at our Munich headquarters or working from home—we’re flexible, and you’ll be happy!

  • Teamwork makes the dream work: We’re a strong team that supports one another and has plenty of fun together, even beyond work and across different locations

 

Sounds like you are the one we’ve been looking for?

Perfect! Then apply now. We look forward to meeting you very soon.

Ihre Aufgaben

data.title: Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS Fintech, Berlin
data.description:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Du willst als Team Lead Sales in Berlin ein Vertriebsteam führen und gleichzeitig mitgestalten, wie Pennylane Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland gewinnt? Als erste Sales-Teamleitung für unser deutsches Kanzleisegment baust du ein Team regionaler Account Executives auf, das Kanzleien aktiv gewinnt – Outbound wie Inbound: Du coachst im Kundengespräch, steuerst die Vertriebsleistung und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director den Ansatz für den deutschen Markt – mit dem Rückenwind eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs Europas.

Deine Mission

Du wirst die oder der erste Team Lead Sales (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien in Deutschland sein. Deine Mission ist es, mit deinem Team von Account Executives Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland für Pennylane zu gewinnen – du führst, coachst und baust das Team aus.

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das bewährte Playbook und passt es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales Firms Director, an den du direkt berichtest, an den deutschen Kanzleimarkt an. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Tobias Janiesch, Managing Director Deutschland, zusammen. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Sales Firms Director, Case Study, Onsite-Gespräch mit dem Team in Berlin.

Dein Team

  • Full-Cycle Sales: Deine Account Executives verantworten den gesamten Prozess – von der Qualifizierung über die Produkt-Demo und den Abschluss bis zum Onboarding und Account Management ihrer Kanzleien.

  • Outbound ist Kern: Einen wesentlichen Teil eurer Pipeline baut ihr selbst auf – per Telefon, LinkedIn, Branchenevents und Kanzleibesuche. Wer nur auf Inbound wartet, wird hier nicht glücklich; wer gern aktiv Türen öffnet, umso mehr.

  • Starkes Setup: Dabei seid ihr nicht allein: Unser eigenes Customer-Success-Team in Berlin unterstützt euch bei Onboarding und Betreuung der Kanzleien, damit deine AEs genug Zeit für die Neukundengewinnung haben.

  • Regional organisiert: Jede:r AE betreut eine feste Region in Deutschland – per Inside Sales und vor Ort in den Kanzleien.

  • Im Aufbau: Du übernimmst aktuell zwei Account Executives und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Talent-Acquisition-Team weitere ein – das Team wächst mit dir.

  • Beratender Vertrieb: Dein Team gewinnt Kanzleiinhaber:innen und Partner:innen für eine neue Art der Zusammenarbeit mit ihren Mandanten. Ihr macht den Nutzen von Pennylane für den Kanzleialltag konkret und schafft Vertrauen in die Einführung einer neuen Plattform.

  • Standort Berlin: Das Team wird aus unserem Berliner Office geführt – du bist an zwei Tagen pro Woche vor Ort, den Rest flexibel. Rund 30 % deiner Zeit bist du bei deinen AEs und in Kanzleien in Deutschland unterwegs, in der Regel ein Termin pro Woche, den du selbst planst.

Du wirst für die Leistung dieses Teams verantwortlich sein durch:

  • Du verantwortest die Vertriebsleistung deines Teams: den MRR aus deutschen Steuerkanzleien und die Marktdurchdringung von Pennylane im deutschen Kanzleisegment.

  • Du baust mit deinem Team eine systematische Outbound-Akquise für Kanzleien auf – Zielkundenlisten, Sequenzen, Events, Vor-Ort-Besuche – und hältst die Aktivitätsquoten hoch.

  • Du schaffst klare Erwartungen, coachst regelmäßig anhand konkreter Kundengespräche und nutzt Pipeline- und Conversion-Daten, um dein Team gezielt weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of Sales den Go-to-Market-Ansatz für Kanzleien weiter (Inside Sales + Field Sales) und setzt ihn mit deinem Team um.

  • Du begleitest deine AEs im Feld – bei Kanzleibesuchen, Branchenevents und Key Deals.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem französischen Sales-Team zusammen und überträgst, was vom Playbook für Deutschland funktioniert.

Als Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien sind deine Ziele vielfältig:

  • Du erreichst die Vertriebsziele des Teams und steuerst das Tagesgeschäft – im Office wie bei den AEs in ihren Regionen.

  • Du verantwortest das Sales Enablement deiner Account Executives: Techniken, Messaging und der gesamte Pennylane-Sales-Prozess.

  • Du begleitest neue AEs durch Onboarding und Ramp-up und führst sie zu ihren Zielen.

  • Du baust Teamgeist, Engagement und Wohlbefinden auf – mit Challenges, Teambuildings und Formaten, die du selbst gestaltest.

  • Du bringst die Perspektive des Kanzleivertriebs in die Sales-OKRs von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

  • Du gehst bei wichtigen Deals selbst mit rein – vor Ort in der Kanzlei oder per Video-Call.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales mit – idealerweise SaaS mit mehrstufigen Deal-Zyklen und mehreren Stakeholdern – und hast bereits ein Sales-Team (AEs / Full-Cycle) erfolgreich geführt. Diese Führungserfahrung ist uns wichtiger als eine bestimmte Jahreszahl.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem – oder hast an Steuerberater:innen, Kanzleien oder andere Berufsträger verkauft. Wenn nicht, bringst du die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast selbst Outbound gemacht und Teams darin geführt: Kaltakquise bei Inhaber:innen und Entscheider:innen schreckt dich nicht – sie ist dein Hebel.

  • Du bist ein Builder: Du hast schon einmal ein Team, einen Markt oder einen Prozess aufgebaut – idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Scale-up) – und baust Vertrauen auf, im Team wie bei Kanzleiinhaber:innen.

  • Du führst über Coaching: Du entwickelst Menschen anhand echter Kundengespräche, mit Daten, klarem Feedback und dem Mut, Entscheidungen zu treffen und durchzuhalten.

  • Du bist offen für Selbstreflexion und fühlst dich wohl dabei, Feedback zu geben und zu empfangen.

  • Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit anderen Abteilungen zusammen – Marketing, Customer Success, Product und dem französischen HQ.

  • Du bist hands-on: Du führst nicht nur vom Dashboard aus, sondern gehst selbst mit in Deals – auch vor Ort.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) – deine Kund:innen sind deutsche Kanzleien – und Englisch auf C1-Niveau für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris.

  • Du lebst in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu ziehen – und du bist gern bei Kunden vor Ort (rund 30 % Reiseanteil).

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 🏢 Berlin, hybrid: zwei Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel.

  • 🌴 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.

  • 💵 Ein attraktives OTE-Paket: Fixgehalt plus variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an den MRR, den dein Team erzielt.

  • 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

  • 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln.

  • 🇫🇷 Onboarding im Pariser HQ, regelmäßiger Austausch mit dem französischen Sales-Team und Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

  • 💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

  • 🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (alle 3 Monate) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar – plus Team-Events in Berlin.

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : ----- Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to ----- Learn more

data.title: Customer Success Manager, Mid Market
data.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager at Harvey, you are the custodian of value for a portfolio of law firms and in-house legal teams across DACH — you own their mutual success plan and their renewal. You connect Harvey's technology and expertise to each customer's goals, moving them along the AI maturity curve so adoption keeps deepening, and you are directly accountable for retaining and growing that relationship. You will run your book as a portfolio, deliver a consistently high-quality customer journey at scale, and partner with Account Executives, Legal Engineers and Product to turn adoption into measurable value and expansion.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver the customer journey: run kickoffs, implementation reviews and QBRs tailored to each customer, anchored on a mutual success plan that ties Harvey to their objectives, priorities and measures of success.

  • Drive adoption and value: engage end users, administrators and senior stakeholders — managing partners, general counsel, heads of innovation — to position Harvey as essential to how their legal work gets done, build on proven use cases, and quantify ROI in business terms.

  • Orchestrate cross-functionally: bring in Sales, Legal Engineering, Deal Desk, Legal and Finance at the right moment, and represent customer needs back to Product and Engineering.

  • Expand: identify and progress expansion opportunities within your accounts, partnering with Account Executives where appropriate.

  • Own the renewal end to end: run your book as a portfolio — knowing whether each account is in Defend, Maintain or Grow, with evidence — build renewal plans and timelines, forecast accurately, lead commercial conversations, negotiate terms and close renewals on or ahead of schedule against a gross and net revenue retention target.

What You Have

Ideal candidates for the Mid-Market CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • 3–4+ years in customer-owning roles at tech or SaaS platforms, including direct ownership of renewals, retention or a commercial / account-management target.

  • A track record of owning and delivering against a revenue, retention or net-revenue-retention number.

  • An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily and can show how it has changed your own output.

  • Experience running the renewal motion end to end — forecasting, renewal planning and leading commercial negotiations.

  • Account management and portfolio planning across a high-volume book of business, including segmentation and revenue-based prioritisation.

  • Quantifying and communicating ROI and measurable business value to customers, grounded in concrete use cases.

  • Identifying at-risk accounts early and executing structured mitigation plans.

  • Mapping an organisation and influencing stakeholders, including economic buyers and executive sponsors.

  • Curiosity about how law firms and legal teams work.

  • Working cross-functionally with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal / Finance and Product teams.

  • Adapting seamlessly in the face of high-speed change and growth, with a strong point of view and proactive self-management.

  • Fluent in German and English; based in or able to travel regularly within Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

data.title: Langfuse - DevRel Engineer, Events & Community (EMEA)
data.description:
Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; across several countries that we hire in.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

data.description:
Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse

Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands.

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations.

You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development.

The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

Everything you build is open source and immediately visible.

All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it.

  • Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience.

  • Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations.

  • Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes.

  • Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it.

  • Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems.

  • Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work?

  • Self-directed and motivated. You know how to develop conviction about what to build and how to ship it. You don’t wait for detailed specs — you investigate the framework, talk to users, and propose the right approach.

  • Excited about open source and developer community. You genuinely enjoy talking to developers about their integration challenges, writing clear documentation, and contributing to open source projects.

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team. Your output is visible and matters. You’re comfortable owning outcomes, not just tasks.

CS or quantitative degree preferred, but not required. We care far more about what you’ve built and your hunger to learn.

data.title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
data.description:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

  • You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

  • No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

  • We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

  • Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

  • Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates.
    The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

  • Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

  • We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements

  • At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

  • As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

  • Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

    • Test Driven Development (TDD)

    • Trunk based development

    • Continuous integration

    • Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves

  • Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

  • Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

  • We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer

  • Become part of an AI revolution!

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub

  • Mental health support through nilo.health

  • Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

  • Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

  • Budget for additional technical equipment

  • Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

  • JobRad® Bike Lease

Note: We welcome applicants at every stage of their career. Your drive and willingness to learn are far more important to us than strict experience requirements.

data.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second, integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB, and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes, with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Golang Backend Foundation: You have a Computer Science degree (or related field) and hands-on experience writing Golang. You will use this foundation to contribute directly to our production backend services from day one at adjoe, rather than writing isolated or throwaway code.

  • Proven Project Portfolio: We look for engineers with tangible projects to show, not just coursework. You will leverage the architectural lessons from your past builds—what worked, why you built it, and what you would change—to design and scale our live systems.

  • Modern Infrastructure Stack: You are comfortable working with REST APIs, version control via Git, and CI/CD pipelines. You will use these core tools, along with your familiarity in cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, to reliably deploy your code into our environments.

  • Iterative Code Ownership: You will work alongside experienced engineers who will rigorously review your pull requests. We need someone who parses technical feedback directly and uses it to continuously refine their system design and coding standards.
