data.description:
As Marqeta’s Vendor Management Senior Analyst you will be responsible for helping build and support a vendor management and strategic sourcing program that maximizes value from our vendor relationships and manages our third party vendor risk. We are looking for someone who is highly motivated to help us build new systems, processes, and improve efficiency .

You will work closely with colleagues and teams across the company to support centralised direct and indirect sourcing and procurement efforts, including responsibility for supporting process creation, strategic sourcing and vendor identification, contract negotiation, ongoing monitoring, RFPs, and relationship management.

The ideal candidate will be someone who is enthusiastic, flexible, detail-oriented, a strategic thinker, passionate about creative problem solving, is exceptional at working cross-functionally, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with many challenges and opportunities.

NOTE: This role can be performed remotely within the UK or from our London, Holborn office.

If you are based within 35 miles of our London office we expect you to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll have

  • Support Marqeta’s strategic sourcing and vendor management vision, processes, and tools.

  • Provide support in procurement/strategic sourcing activities, including supporting contract negotiation, administration, amendment and cancellation, and coordinating activities with the legal, compliance, security, and finance teams, as appropriate.

  • Monitor performance metrics relating to the strategic sourcing/procurement program and vendor performance, suggest improvements across any areas of concern, and promptly escalate critical issues to senior management.

  • Continuously identify and drive opportunities to optimize strategic sourcing and vendor management processes without compromising quality, risk management, or service levels.

  • Conduct savings analyses and modeling to prioritise procurement savings opportunities, build recommendations, and track savings achieved as a result of strategic sourcing initiatives.

  • Identify and assess potential risks associated with vendor relationships and implement risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans.

  • Coordinate with internal teams to provide support and guidance on vendor-related matters and oversee the resolution of any issues.

  • Maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure cost, quality, and delivery targets are met.

  • Support the monitoring of vendor compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

  • Support the company’s sustainability and business continuity through active sourcing of suitable vendors.

 

Who You Are

  • 3-5+ years of experience in strategic sourcing and vendor management. This experience should ideally be within Payments, FinTech, Banking, and/or SaaS-based technology companies. A diverse mix of experience across these industries is highly desirable, as opposed to experience solely within the banking sector.

  • Proven track record of assisting in contract negotiations. This includes experience in reviewing redlines, ensuring the inclusion of appropriate provisions, and safeguarding the organization's interests.

  • Understanding of the regulatory requirements and risk management processes in the payments/fintech/banking industry.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and handle a high volume of work. Must be able to prioritize tasks effectively, maintain a high level of productivity, and meet tight deadlines without compromising the quality of work.

  • Experience working with vendor-supplied contracts ("vendor's paper"). This includes the ability to review, and manage contracts provided by vendors, ensuring that all agreements align with company interests and compliance requirements.

  • Able to operate without already defined or established processes, tools, or templates.

  • Able to influence and guide decisions across multiple cross functional teams.

     

Your Recruiter

  • Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!)

     

Typical Process

  • Application Submission

  • Recruiter video call

  • Hiring manager video call

  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 3 - 4 x 45 min calls

  • Offer!

     

Compensation and Benefits (for Full Time Roles)

  • Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

  • Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development

  • Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Wellbeing programs i.e. Modern Health, HealthKick and much more…

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

The Risk & Compliance team sits within Finance and is responsible for enterprise risk management, the internal controls framework, regulatory compliance, external certifications and client audits. We are a small, high-impact team that works across the whole business, from Sales and Product to Engineering, Security and the Board. We support our clients through due diligence, audits and assurance activities, and we help the business grow responsibly as we scale.

About the role

We are looking for a Risk & Compliance Analyst to join the team and strengthen our capability across risk management and compliance and controls. You will play a hands-on role in running our risk management framework, keeping us ahead of the regulatory landscape in our current and target markets, and supporting the testing and improvement of our controls framework. This is a broad role with excellent exposure to senior stakeholders and a real opportunity to shape how a fast-growing fintech manages risk.

DUTIES

Risk Management

  • Support the annual enterprise risk assessment and departmental risk reviews, working with risk owners to identify, assess and track risks and mitigating actions.

  • Maintain the risk register and help produce risk reporting and metrics for the Governance, Risk & Compliance Committee (GRCC), Senior Management and the Board Risk & Audit Committee (BRAC).

  • Contribute to improvements in our risk reporting, including dashboards and establishing key risk indicators.

Compliance

  • Run compliance horizon scanning, tracking regulatory and legislative developments relevant to Thought Machine and its banking clients.

  • Lead the refresh of local regulatory assessments for our current and target markets.

  • Provide day-to-day compliance advice to the business and support policy maintenance and attestation.

Client and Business Support

  • Support Sales and Partnerships with due diligence requests, RFPs and client risk questionnaires.

Requirements

Essential

  • 2–4 years' experience in risk management, compliance, internal audit or controls assurance, ideally in financial services, fintech, SaaS or a Big Four / consultancy environment.

  • Working knowledge of risk management frameworks and internal controls concepts (e.g. risk and control self-assessment, control design and operating effectiveness testing).

  • A robust understanding of quantitative risk approaches and how these are applied in project and operational risk situations.

  • Understanding of the regulatory environment for financial services and/or technology providers to regulated firms (e.g. operational resilience, outsourcing and third-party requirements, DORA, data protection).

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn findings into clear, concise reporting for senior audiences.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and confidence working with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Highly organised, able to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a small team.

Desirable

  • Exposure to SOC 1 / SOC 2 (ISAE 3402 / 3000), ISO 27001 or similar audit and certification programmes.

  • Experience with GRC tooling, and an interest in using data, automation or AI to improve risk and compliance processes.

  • A relevant qualification or progress towards one (e.g. ICA, IRM, CISA, ACCA/ACA, CIA).

We actively hire candidates who demonstrate technical excellence in their field and welcome people of all ages and backgrounds, providing everyone with equal access to professional development. You are encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't accurately match the job description. data.title: AI Resident UK/EMEA
data.description:
About Ema

Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.

We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

The residency

The AI Residency is a 6-month builder role, not a research placement. Every engineer at Ema owns delivery end to end — from understanding the customer's problem to shipping, measuring and supporting it in production — and residents are held to the same bar. You won't be parked on one project: you'll contribute across several avenues, all toward one goal — creating real value and impact for our enterprise customers.

  • Real production work. You work in the production codebase, on real customer problems and real production data. Recent residents have shipped agent harnesses, eval infrastructure, inference-cost reductions, PII redaction, automated QA pipelines and backend service hardening used by enterprise customers.

  • End-to-end ownership. You take work from a problem statement to a shipped, measured result — design, build, test, launch, and the follow-through until it's reliable.

  • Mentorship. A senior mentor, weekly 1:1s, regular reviews with your team, and exposure to the founders and engineering leadership.

  • A path to full-time. Top-performing residents are offered full-time roles at Ema. Several of our engineers started as residents.

Choose your specialist track

Whichever track you choose, you own delivery end to end. The track decides where you go deepest.

  • Backend. Go and Python services, APIs and data models for multi-tenant SaaS. Integrations that let agents take real actions in SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, Teams and Slack.

  • AI/ML. Agents, harnesses and context engineering; evals and LLM judges calibrated against human labels; retrieval and memory; post-training (SFT, preference optimisation, RL) and distilling frontier behaviour into cheaper models.

  • Systems & Infra. Kubernetes and cloud (Azure, GCP), regional deployments and data residency, model serving, observability, CI/CD and reliability at enterprise scale.

Where you'll contribute

Over the residency you'll work across several of these avenues, not just one:

  • Customer deployments. Build and ship AI Employees for UK and European enterprises, working with the people whose problem it is.

  • Platform and product. Turn patterns from the field into Ema's core product: new connectors, agent primitives, APIs and tooling.

  • Quality and evaluation. Make agents measurably better: benchmarks from real workflows, failure mining, and the loop where production traces become training and eval data.

  • Reliability and cost. Latency, uptime, inference cost and observability. Quality per pound is a metric we track.

  • Trust and compliance. PII detection and redaction, data residency, and audit-ready evidence for customers under UK GDPR and the EU AI Act.

What we're looking for

  • A builder's mindset and high agency. You find a way to ship rather than waiting for the blocker to clear, and you follow your work into production.

  • Final-year undergraduates, MSc/MEng and PhD students, recent graduates and self-taught builders are all welcome. What matters is what you've built.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and clean code in Python, Go or a similar language. You're comfortable in a large production codebase.

  • Real depth in your chosen track. Backend: services, APIs and data modelling. AI/ML: ML fundamentals, PyTorch, LLM systems or evals. Systems & Infra: Linux, containers, cloud and networking. One area you can teach us beats five you've touched.

  • Honest measurement as a habit. You define what "done" and "better" mean before you build, and you'd rather kill your own feature with a clean experiment than ship it on a hunch.

  • Clear communication. You can explain your work to engineers, customers and leadership, in writing and in person.

Show us what you've built

The best way to capture our attention is to point us to something you've built. Include a link — a GitHub repo, a live URL, a demo, or a write-up — with your application.

Logistics

  • Location: Hybrid, from our London office.

  • Term: 6 months, flexible start.

  • Stipend: £ 2,500 - £ 3,000 / month.

  • Right to work: You must have the right to work in the UK for the length of the residency.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

data.title: People Partner - Paris France
data.description:
Job Title: People Partner - Paris France

Location: Hybrid

 

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software .

As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace.

Job Summary:

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle for our team in France. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices in line with French employment law across our Paris office and global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale.

Key Responsibilities:

What you'll do

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, working time and leave (forfait jours, congés payés, RTT) and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations under French law and the applicable convention collective, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Serve as the local first line of defence for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to French labour law (Code du travail), the applicable collective bargaining agreement (convention collective), site-specific contracts and health and safety obligations, including keeping the DUERP (workplace risk assessment) up to date.

  • Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive or high-impact situations, monitor recurring issues and operational risks, and ensure that incidents are resolved at their root cause, with appropriate care for the employees involved.

  • Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the Paris office.

  • Draft, review and interpret French employment contracts, amendments (avenants), non-compete clauses with their required financial compensation, and working time arrangements such as forfait jours for cadres.

  • Manage hiring formalities and onboarding under French law, including the DPAE, the registre unique du personnel, the initial occupational health visit (visite d’information et de prévention), and probation periods (périodes d’essai) and their renewal.

  • Support pre-litigation and litigation before the Conseil de prud’hommes, working closely with our external employment lawyers (avocats en droit social).

  • Review, update and maintain Radiant’s French people policies.Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

  • Ensure compliance with French employment legislation, collective agreements, internal policies and regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with our external payroll provider on monthly payroll and DSN filings, and manage mandatory benefits, including the mutuelle and prévoyance schemes, and occupational health (médecine du travail) follow-up.

  • Manage training obligations, including the plan de développement des compétences, working with our OPCO, and supporting employees’ use of their CPF (compte personnel de formation).

Compliance

  • Help ensure compliance with French employment law and best practice across France and the wider EU, in consultation with the UK-based People team and external French employment counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet French employment law, GDPR and CNIL requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

  • Monitor headcount thresholds (11, 50 and 250 employees) and prepare Radiant for the obligations each one triggers, such as the CSE, the règlement intérieur, gender equality reporting and mandatory profit-sharing (participation).

  • Act as the main point of contact for the labour inspectorate (inspection du travail) and the occupational health service, and keep mandatory registers and workplace notices (affichages obligatoires) up to date.

Employee representation (CSE)

  • Set up the CSE once the Paris office reaches 11 employees for 12 consecutive months, including negotiating the protocole d’accord préélectoral and organising professional elections.

  • Run information and consultation processes with the CSE on reorganisations, policy changes and other matters that require it, and set up the BDESE once we reach 50 employees.

  • Build a constructive relationship with employee representatives and prepare for collective bargaining, including the mandatory annual negotiations (NAO) where union delegates are appointed.

Immigration and visas

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand across Europe, including UK–France moves, secondments and posted worker (détachement) requirements.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale, including the CSE consultation and French legal requirements that apply to any reorganisation.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process, alongside the mandatory entretiens professionnels every two years and the six-yearly summary review (état des lieux récapitulatif).

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance (insuffisance professionnelle) through fair, well-documented processes that would stand up before the Conseil de prud’hommes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role in France, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of French employment law (Code du travail, conventions collectives, CSE obligations, working time rules) and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • Hands-on experience running disciplinary and dismissal procedures, ruptures conventionnelles and CSE information and consultation processes.

  • Familiarity with French payroll (DSN), mandatory benefits and statutory reporting.

  • Fluent French and strong professional English, written and spoken.

  • A degree in HR or employment law (e.g. Master 2 RH or droit social), or equivalent experience.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate to external counsel.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters, particularly working alongside a UK headquarters, is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

 

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

data.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped.

At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners.

You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind.


This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem.


What You'll Do

  • Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations.

  • Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners.

  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm.

  • Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables.

  • Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform.

  • Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity.

  • Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery.

  • Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly.

  • Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers.

What You Bring

  • Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment.

  • Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum.

  • Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery.

  • Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction.

  • A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time.

  • Native level french speaking.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery

  • Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments

  • Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcare data standards

  • Experience working with platform or API products

  • Some hands-on technical experience (e.g. scripting, debugging, light coding)

  • Experience scaling integration processes or working with multiple external partners

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This role is based in our Paris office, where you will work primarily on-site with the local team, while collaborating closely with colleagues at our HQ in Stockholm.

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  • Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical interview with some of our Engineering team

  • Follow-up interview with one of our Team Leads

  • Home case and presentation at our Paris office - Join us for a lunch, a discovery meeting and a presentation to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

data.title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Evaluation Platform (x/f/m)
data.description:
Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

 

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

 

What you'll do

 

We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems.

 

Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice.

 

In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib

  • Work hands-on with product teams to assess how they evaluate today, define improvement plans, and help them own their evaluation quality

  • Design evaluation strategies for agentic systems, combining deterministic checks, LLM-as-a-judge, simulation-based testing, and human review

  • Build intelligent capabilities for production sampling, dataset representativeness monitoring, distribution-shift detection, and test case generation

  • Help teams define meaningful quality metrics, representative datasets, and reliable quality gates throughout the development lifecycle

  • Turn recurring product needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities, and measure success through adoption, team autonomy, and evaluation coverage

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's AI platform and best practices for building and evaluating agentic systems

 

Who you are

 

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next team mate if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant experience using Python; or as a machine learning engineer

  • Have built or operated evaluation for LLM-powered or agentic systems: datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review, production-driven evaluation

  • Understand and promote software development best practices

  • Are product-oriented and enjoy working directly with other teams, challenging assumptions, and turning complex needs into concrete solutions

  • Can influence engineering practices and drive change without hierarchical authority: your job is not done until your solution is adopted

  • Are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with applied ML techniques such as embeddings, clustering, statistical sampling, and distribution monitoring

  • Have experience building developer platforms or internal tooling, or in a Forward Deployed Engineering role

  • Have experience in the medical domain or another regulated environment

 

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 

The interview process

  • A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team

  • A coding interview

  • An agentics system design

  • A behavioural interview

  • Reference check

 

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Full Time

  • Workplace: Levallois

  • Start date : As soon as possible

 

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles!

 

At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from, what you look like. This translates into our recruitment process: Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We don't just accept diversity at Doctolib, we respect and celebrate it!

 

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin. If you have a disability, let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process smoother for you!

data.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Join us as a Strategic Project Manager – Strategic Planning & Insights to help shape Qonto’s strategy and turn priorities into action. Working with Fanny, our Strategy Director, and senior stakeholders across Qonto, you’ll assess opportunities, inform key decisions and lead cross-functional projects through to execution.

You’ll join a Strategy talent pool where you can learn quickly, collaborate across teams and potentially grow into another function over time, such as Growth, Operations, Product or Tech.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Shape strategic planning and priorities: Contribute to Qonto’s strategic planning process, help define company-wide priorities and turn them into company OKRs and key projects. Track progress and help assess when priorities need to evolve. Work with Corporate Development to articulate Qonto’s vision and strategy for internal and external audiences.

  • Build market and strategic insights: Analyze market trends, customer needs and Qonto’s competitive position to assess opportunities, develop clear and actionable recommendations and support decision-making, particularly for Product, Growth, Ops and Corporate Development.

  • Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Lead cross-functional initiatives or bring strategic input to unblock a team’s project across new products and adjacencies, growth acceleration and operational efficiency.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm and/or as a strategic project manager in a startup or company. Experience in banking or financial services is a plus, not a requirement; curiosity about the sector is important.

  • Strategic thinking & analysis: You enjoy exploring complex questions, combining market and customer insights with quantitative and financial analysis to build structured, actionable recommendations.

  • Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present insights to a range of audiences, including senior stakeholders.

  • Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects with autonomy, bring people together around shared goals and break down silos to move work forward.

  • Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for moving from an idea or recommendation to concrete action and follow through on delivery.

  • Curiosity & AI: You’re eager to learn, explore new opportunities and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

  • Languages: Fluent English is required; French or another European language is a plus.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Team & impact: Join a Strategy team working on high-impact topics across Qonto, from strategic planning and new products to growth acceleration and operational efficiency.

  • Exposure & collaboration: Work closely with senior management and colleagues across functions on a variety of strategic challenges in an international fintech environment.

  • From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business and see your recommendations move beyond the slide deck into real projects and outcomes.

  • Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

  • AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Fanny De Vesinne-Larüe, our Strategy Director.

  • Her background: Fanny has been at Qonto for four years, spotting new opportunities and driving key projects to help Qonto accelerate. Before joining Qonto, she held roles across strategy, marketing, venture and e-business at financial institutions including AXA and BNP Paribas, working with fintechs and startups.

  • What she brings to the team: Fanny supports team members through coaching, exposure to different functions and conversations about their development and potential future moves within Qonto.

  • Investigations and reconciliations: Track down discrepancies, make corrections, reconcile supplier accounts and apply internal controls. You will also answer supplier and internal requests that come in by email and Slack.

  • Month-end closing: Support the general accounting team on closing tasks every month, and cover for your AP colleagues when they are away.

  • Projects: Contribute to AP initiatives and to system migrations or implementations (we rolled out SAP early this year), and train colleagues over time.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • AP experience: At least 2 years in an end-to-end accounts payable role, in any industry (bank, manufacturing, services…). You have booked invoices, run payments and handled reconciliations yourself. Fintech experience is not required.

  • P2P and ERP tools: Hands-on use of at least one P2P or ERP tools (Coupa and SAP are our main ones, Oracle or Sage are good transferable experience), plus invoice OCR validation and a solid Excel level.

  • Investigation skills: You follow a discrepancy through to the end, whether it sits with a supplier or an internal team, and you can describe a complex case you resolved.

  • Ownership and organisation: You manage daily invoices, a weekly payment run and a monthly close without losing track of any of them, and you take topics from start to finish without waiting to be asked.

  • Languages: Professional English is required, as it is our team language. Spanish, Italian, French or German are a plus, since we cover several Qonto entities.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A permanent role with your own portfolio: You handle your own set of entities and suppliers, with peers to back you up on the more complex investigations and reconciliations.

  • Systems that keep evolving: The team regularly migrates and implements new tools (SAP early this year). You will help shape how AP works rather than only run it.

  • A view across all company spend: Because every expense passes through AP, you will see how Qonto’s spending is recorded and closed. You will work closely with the General Accounting and FP&A teams.

  • A team across several sites: The role is based in Paris or Belgrade. We work in English, and the team shares coverage of each other’s topics.

data.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions. You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks.

Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams, and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance.

  • Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder

  • Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases.

  • Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements.

  • Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently.

  • Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments.

  • Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders.

  • Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software.

data.title: Founding sales lead
data.description:
Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

  • Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

  • Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

  • Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 Your mission

  • Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

  • Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

  • Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

  • Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

  • Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

  • Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

  • Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

  • Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 How you will be measured

  • First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

  • 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

  • 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 This job is your dream job if:

  • You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

  • You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

  • You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

  • You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

  • You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 This job is not for you if:

  • You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

  • You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

  • You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

  • Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

  • You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

What we offer

  • A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

  • Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

  • Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

🧭 Our recruitment process

  1. A first call to get to know each other.

  2. A deep dive into two deals you closed.

  3. A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders.

  4. A conversation with the founders.

  5. Reference checks, with your consent.

  6. Offer.

We answer after each step.

Pelagon is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origin, identity, background and sexual orientation.

data.title: Senior Optical Design Engineer
data.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.


Overview
 
We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English. 
 

What you will be doing

  • Design and optimize lenses and optical systems, from first-order layout to detailed optimization with ray tracing and physical optics propagation (POP). 

  • Carry out tolerance analysis and Monte Carlo simulations to predict manufacturing and assembly yield, and define realistic tolerances with suppliers. 

  • Conduct STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analysis with mechanical engineers, verifying performance and margins across operating conditions. 

  • Conduct stray light analysis. 

  • Produce lens and optomechanical drawings, and work with mechanical engineers to ensure designs are manufacturable and assemblable. 

  • Define assembly, alignment, and bonding procedures, and support their implementation in clean room environments. 

  • Plan and execute lab assembly and test, covering alignment, characterization, and performance verification of prototypes and flight-representative hardware. 

  • Characterize components and assemblies through optical metrology, and identify discrepancies. Drive root-cause investigations and design iterations. 

  • Work with suppliers on design for manufacturing, tolerancing, inspection, qualification, and pre-production runs.


    • What you bring to this role

  • A Master’s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, with a strong foundation in geometrical and physical optics. 

  • 5+ years of experience in optical design, including lens and optical system design, optimization and STOP analysis. 

  • Proficiency in Zemax OpticStudio, including sequential ray tracing and optimization. 

  • Hands-on lab experience in optical assembly and test, with working knowledge of metrology instruments such as interferometers, wavefront sensors, MTF benches, autocollimators, and centration measurement tools. 

  • Experience with spaceborne optics or qualification to space-relevant standards, such as ECSS. Selection of adhesives, coatings and optics materials. 

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot problems across simulation and hardware. 

  • A proactive mindset and a commitment to high standards of quality and performance. 


    • Bonus points

  • Experience with free space optical communication systems. 

  • Python and ZOS-API skills for automating analysis or processing data. 

  • Experience with ANOVA methodology, including Gauge R&R studies and statistical post-processing in tools such as JMP. 

  • Practical knowledge of cleanroom practice, optics cleaning, adhesive bonding.

Tu rejoindras cette équipe dans laquelle tu travailleras sur les fondations analytiques, la couche sémantique et la gouvernance de la donnée. Il s’agit d’un rôle transverse qui sera en interface avec les besoins métiers et des autres praticiens•nes data.

Tu seras en charge de renforcer et développer nos fondations data afin de fluidifier le travail de l’ensemble des métiers et praticiens•nes data.
 
Ainsi, tes principales missions seront les suivants : 

Modélisation de données et couche sémantique :

  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des modèles de données partagés, au service des besoins métiers (notamment financiers) et de la direction

  • Être un point de référent technique pour l’ensemble des équipes financières et achats d’énergie

  • Structurer et organiser la gouvernance de données afin de garantir une seul et même source de vérité


    • Assurer la qualité de données et les standards :

  • Être garant de la qualité de nos modèles de données via la diffusion des bonnes pratiques et le suivi de la qualité de nos données

  • Éviter les redondances et l’accumulation de dettes techniques afin d’avoir un lineage propre.

  • Gérer les incidents sur nos modèles les plus critiques


    • Animer et faire monter en compétence la communauté data :

  • Animer ou co-animer des formations, du coaching et des routines dédiés aux équipes data

  • Être moteur de la transition IA de notre stack: création de skills, démonstration d’exemple et de cas d’usage

  • Assurer la qualité du code via les revues de code (PR reviews) sur les modèles dbt et les requêtes SQL produits par les autres praticiens data


    • Assurer la coordination internationale :

  • S’assurer de la cohérence et être le relais des pratiques communes du groupe Octopus Energy

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration de nos modèles partagés


    • Profil recherché :

  • Expérience & Compétences techniques

  • Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en analytical engineering, data engineering analytique, ou analytics avec une forte orientation technique

  • Maîtrise avancée de dbt : expérience sur des projets de taille réelle, avec gestion de la structure, de la documentation et des tests

  • SQL expert — capable d'optimiser des requêtes complexes sur un data warehouse moderne (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks ou équivalent)

  • Tu es à l’aise en Python pour l'automatisation et les scripts analytiques, en connaissant les bonnes pratiques de développement

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les outils de visualisation de données et les pratiques de gestion programmatique de ces outils (ex.: “dashboard-as-a-code”).

  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des patterns d'architecture analytique : Kimball, Data Vault, Medallion, ou hybride — et surtout du pourquoi derrière chaque choix

  • Expérience en gestion de la qualité de données

  • Parcours académique en statistiques / mathématique / économie, diplôme spécialisé en data, ou en école d’Ingénieur avec une forte appétence en Data

  • Appétences et Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Rigueur et souci du détail : la qualité de la donnée commence par la qualité du code

  • Pédagogie et envie de faire monter les autres en compétences pour éviter de créer des silos

  • Tu es à l'aise dans un environnement décentralisé : tu dois convaincre par la qualité de ton travail et la clarté de tes recommandations auprès des praticiens·nes data

  • Tu aimes les environnements dynamiques: Octopus Energy évoluent vite et les besoins peuvent changer

  • Notre stack:

  • Visualisation: Lightdash et Streamlit

  • Modélisation: dbt

  • Lakehousing: Databricks (sur AWS)

  • Orchestration: Airflow

  • Code: Git

  • IA: Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini

  • Langues: tu maîtrise de l'anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit pour interagir avec nos collègues internationaux


    • Ce que tu trouveras ici :
  • Un rôle avec une vraie surface d'impact transversale en travaillant sur une communauté data d'une quinzaine de praticiens actifs — tes décisions techniques affectent l’ensemble de la data d’Octopus Energy France. La culture Octopus Energy valorise l'autonomie et la responsabilité individuelles.

  • Le poste est basé à Paris avec 3 jours de présentiel et 2 jours de télétravail

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! data.title: Lead Mechanical Engineer H/F Heat Pumps - France
data.description:
Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need loads more people to help us make our vision a reality.

We're recruiting our first Lead Mechanical Engineer to supervise the installations of our Air Source Heat Pumps. We're looking for passionate people who have experience installing heating systems and are willing to help us grow this activity in France


This is a field based role covering the Amiens area, but you’ll also be expected to work from home or from our Lille office when required.


What you'll do
  • You’ll help us set up the technical arm of our heat pump department in France
  • You’ll ensure the quality and proper functioning of the installations carried out by our local partners
  • You’ll  be out in the field visiting construction sites to ensure they are running smoothly
  • You’ll be able to provide technical support to resolve any issues identified on site directly
  • You’ll have a “troubleshooter” mindset to find solutions to challenges and resolve them 
  • You’ll use your knowledge and experience of heat pump installations to ensure a seemless and outstanding experience
  • You’ll share low carbon advice with our customers
  • You’ll review and collaborate on technical specifications and mechanical drawings

    • What you'll need
  • 3+ years of experience installing and maintaining air source heat pump systems 
  • Happy to travel around the Amiens region 
  • You’ll be an experienced plumbing and heating engineer with knowledge of heating system design and the ability to fault find
  • You’ll have experience of reviewing and challenging technical specifications & mechanical drawings 



    • Qualifications
  • Clean French Driving licence
  • CAP/BEP, or VAE level
  • You previously worked within companies with RGE & Qualibat certifications (or owned them if you were self-employed)
  • Technical English proficiency (B1) 
  • BR NF C18-510 electrical habilitation 
    • It would be great if you had some of the below too:
  • Happy using computers, including Excel  
  • Some experience with the electrical side of heat pumps 
  • BR electrical qualification

    • What we offer
  • Salary : €2900 a month
  • Insurance company participation
  • Additional salary for overtime/on-call
  • 10€ per working day lunch vouchers (“Tickets-restaurants”) 
  • Share options in Octopus Energy
  • Use of company tools
  • Uniform and all PPE
  • Company Vehicle and fuel

data.title: Comptable sénior H/F
data.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

Tes missions
Gross margin et comptabilité énergie
  • Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers
  • Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation
  • Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive
    • Fiscalité énergie et TVA
  • Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA
  • Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes
  • Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting
    • Supervision et contrôle
  • Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations
    • Structuration et amélioration continue
  • Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre
  • Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite
  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles
  • Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance

    • Ce que l'on attend de toi
    De ton arrivée à 3 mois :
  • Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office
  • Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin
  • Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre
    • De 4 à 6 mois :
  • Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils
  • Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation)
    • Au-delà de 6 mois :
  • Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre

    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise
  • Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus
  • Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes
  • Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée
  • Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée
  • Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni
    • Ce qui fera la différence :
  • Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas
  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer
  • Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite
  • Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT)

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

data.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager - GTM
data.description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

The Mission 🪐

  • The Situation: Malt is actively shaping the "New Way of Work." As a European scale-up with over 600 employees across Europe, UK, UAE, and more than 1 million freelancers on our platform, we are in a thrilling growth phase—bolstered by a new Executive team. As we rapidly expand our footprint, we are treating this role as the foundation of a critical internal business unit.   • Forged strong, collaborative partnerships across commercial, product, and marketing organizations, adjusting communication styles seamlessly to influence diverse global cultures.

data.description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:

We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML).

Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion.

Some of the questions you might explore :

- How is the freelancing market evolving in time ?  What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions?

- What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? 

- How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior?


Key responsibilities ✨

  • Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency.

  • Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation: Formulate falsifiable economic hypotheses, design quasi-experimental and experimental setups (Diff-in-Diff, Instrumental Variables, Fixed Effects), and isolate true causal mechanisms within complex, multi-sided platform interactions.

  • External Research & Flagship Thought Leadership: Co-author Malt’s research publications as well as macroeconomic barometers in close partnership with Marketing, translating raw platform telemetry into compelling public narratives for industry leaders and tier-1 media.

  • Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, ML, Marketing, and C-Suite stakeholders to identify high-impact research questions, challenge assumptions, and uncover underlying economic mechanisms. 

  • Hands-On Data Engineering & Modeling: Write clean SQL on BigQuery and engineer robust, reproducible analytical pipelines in Python, leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to maximize research velocity.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Academic Foundation: PhD (or Master's degree with equivalent proven empirical research track record) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Social Sciences, or a related empirical discipline. Strong Quantitative and Research Background

  • Empirical Econometrics & Modeling: Proven expertise in microeconomic modeling, causal inference, and empirical identification strategies (e.g., panel data, Instrumental Variables, Diff-in-Diff, selection models).

  • Applied Research Mindset: You combine scientific rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving real-world economic problems. You know how to adapt your methods and the depth of your analyses to the question at hand.

  • Hands-On Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels, SciPy) and high-level SQL on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, Snowflake).

  • Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to scope ambiguous problems, communicate complex econometric findings to non-technical leaders, and constructively challenge stakeholder assumptions.

  • Full professional proficiency in English. 

    • If you're excited about using unique marketplace data to explore meaningful economic questions, shape real-world decisions, and contribute to a deeper understanding of the future of work, we'd love to hear from you!


    How to join the mission? 🚀

DFT Engineer
data.description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort.

  • Strong hands-on experience with one major DFT suite: Siemens Tessent, Synopsys TestMAX / DFTMAX / TetraMAX, or Cadence Modus.

  • Scan insertion and test compression (EDT / DFTMAX / Modus-type).

  • MBIST and memory repair integration.

  • JTAG / IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), IEEE 1500 wrappers.

  • ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, path delay), coverage analysis and improvement.

  • DFT verification: gate-level simulation of patterns, timing-aware checks.

  • Test-mode SDC / STA understanding.

  • Scripting: Tcl, Python.

  • Experience in silicon bring-up and ATE debug.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Define DFT architecture and test strategy — coverage targets, test time, pin budget — in collaboration with Siemens experts and our design team.

  • Implement hands-on: scan insertion, compression, MBIST, JTAG/IJTAG/IEEE 1500 wrappers, ATPG, sign-off.

  • Drive DFT verification: gate-level simulation of test patterns and timing-aware checks.

  • Support physical design and STA for test modes — constraints, scan timing closure.

  • Be the bridge between RTL design, physical implementation, and the ATE / test house for silicon bring-up.

  • Deliver patterns to ATE and debug failing patterns with the test house.

  • Contribute to DFT tool evaluation and set up a reusable, scalable flow.

Preferred Qualification

  • Experience at advanced nodes (7nm and below).

  • Experience with large AI/HPC or multi-core SoCs, NoC-based designs.

  • Hierarchical DFT on large designs.

  • Has participated in a DFT tool selection or flow setup from scratch.

  • Logic BIST, in-system test, or functional safety (ISO 26262) exposure.

  • Yield analysis and diagnosis (e.g. Tessent Diagnosis, YieldInsight).

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.
