Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies.

The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. You'd join as Chief of Staff to Loïc, our CEO. Your job is to create leverage for him across everything in his perimeter: external meetings, strategy, his public voice and investor relations. You support the CEO's decisions; you don't make them for him. Investor relationships stay with the CEO and the leadership team.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Let Loïc take on 3x more external meetings with military, political and industry stakeholders: prepare the materials, send pre-reads ahead, run the follow-up, coordinate with points of contact, and help define what each meeting needs to achieve

  • Support the leadership team's strategy work: bring the right inputs, pace the process so decisions actually get taken, and make sure they're communicated

  • Build the CEO's external voice: draft LinkedIn posts, articles, thought pieces and panel or interview prep to a v0.5 he can iterate on (v0.9 once you're fully in his head), own the communications calendar, and make sure what's planned ships

  • Run investor reporting: act as board secretary, prepare monthlies and board meetings (decks, Notion docs and other materials), keep the data room ready, and support preparation for our next fundraise

  • Track priorities across the company, catch what's falling through the cracks, and make sure the right people are moving on the right things

  • Build genuine trust with a small, fast-moving leadership team

 

Who We're Looking For

We filter hardest on autonomy, humility and grit. We want sharp, hard-working people with real team spirit, who drive things to completion without being told exactly how.

Must-have

  • Around 4 years of experience, including time at a seed-stage startup

  • Real experience operating close to a CEO or senior executive in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment, not a project management background alone

  • Strong writing and structuring skills: you can turn a messy conversation into a clear deck, memo or post

  • Strong generalist judgment: comfortable moving between external meetings, strategy, communications and investor work in the same week

  • Genuine discretion with sensitive and confidential information

  • Comfortable driving alignment and pushing back on stakeholders without formal authority

  • EU citizenship

  • Based in Paris, working in person with the CEO

  • Fluency in both French and English

Nice to have

  • Experience in a large organisation as well as a startup

  • Some exposure to fundraising, board reporting, or investor relations

 

What's In It For You

  • Competitive package (top 0.1% of compensation in Europe: base + equity)

The Process

1. Talent screening (optional): 30 min, online. Background and motivation.

2. CEO fit: 30 min, with Loïc.

3. Investor fit: 30 min, with one of our investors.

4. Onsite in Paris: full day.

data.title: Thermo-Mechanical Engineer
data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engines, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

 

We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces.

  • Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development.

  • Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation.

  • Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance.

  • Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware.

  • Own structural reliability and lifecycle assessments of combustion hardware, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, and thermo-mechanical failure risk evaluation.

  • Collaborate with combustion and fluid engineers to translate predicted heat flux distributions, pressure fields, and flow characteristics into structural and thermal design requirements

  • Define structural and thermal instrumentation strategies for development testing and participate post-test data reduction, model validation, and correlation activities.

  • Contribute to material selection and design trades considering temperature capability, strength, fatigue resistance, oxidation compatibility, and cryogenic behavior.

  • Prepare technical documentation and contribute to design, and test reviews with clear technical justification and risk assessment.

 

What we would love to see from you

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience (academic, internship, or professional) in structural or thermal analysis of high-performance mechanical systems.

  • Strong fundamentals in solid mechanics, heat transfer, and pressure-loaded structures.

  • Experience with FEA tools such as ANSYS, NASTRAN, Abaqus, or equivalent.

  • Ability to interpret complex thermal and pressure boundary conditions and apply them appropriately in structural models.

  • Understanding of fatigue, temperature-dependent material behavior, and nonlinear structural response.

  • Exposure to high-temperature or cryogenic systems is advantageous.

  • Familiarity with CAD (NX ideally) tools and ability to work directly with geometry.

  • Experience with Python or similar scripting tools for analysis automation or data processing is beneficial.

 

Skills and Behaviours

  • Methodical and structured approach to problem solving.

  • Strong attention to detail and analytical rigor.

  • Clear written and verbal communication of technical rationale.

  • Ability to iterate analyses as design and test data evolve.

  • Interest in propulsion systems and combustion device development.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence, and Teamwork.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. data.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The role

You will own the ERP that runs Alta Ares: purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, sales, projects

and finance. As we move from prototypes to series production and expand internationally, your

job is to make the ERP keep pace: integrate the modules end to end, make sure the data is

reliable, and give every team a system that supports how they really work.

What you'll do

Run and develop the ERP

  • Own the ERP roadmap, in line with company priorities and the needs of each team

  • Configure and integrate the modules end to end: Purchase, Inventory, Manufacturing

(MRP), Quality, Sales, Project and Accounting

  • Manage integrations between the ERP and our other tools (PLM, HRIS, banking, BI)

  • Lead ERP partners and developers on custom developments, upgrades and version

migrations


Support the industrial scale-up

  • Set up the flows needed for series production: bills of materials, routings, planning, stock

and serial-number traceability

  • Work with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and Engineering to map processes and

translate them into the ERP

  • Support multi-entity set-up across France, the UK, the UAE and Germany

control

Data and users

  • Guarantee master data quality: items, suppliers, customers, prices

  • Build reports and dashboards for management and operational teams

Who you are

  • 3 to 6 years of ERP experience, in-house or as a consultant

  • Required: hands-on ERP experience, including the integration of several modules

(purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, accounting) into one working system

  • Required: experience in a company scaling up, ideally in defense, aerospace or another

industrial sector

  • Good understanding of industrial and supply chain processes: bills of materials,

production, stock, traceability

  • Able to turn business needs into clear specifications and drive partners and developers to

deliver them

  • Rigorous with data, and pragmatic: you favour solutions that work now over perfect ones

  • Fluent French and English

  • Eligible for French national security clearance

data.title: Head of Cybersecurity
data.description:
About Us

KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions.

We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset.

At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success.

Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture

  • Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap.

  • Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment.

  • Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions.

  • Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001.

  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates.

  • Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations.

  • Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice.

2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership

  • Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams.

  • Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls.

  • Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required.

  • Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment.

  • Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation.

  • Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering

  • Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering.

  • Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition.

  • Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs.

  • Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments.

  • Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue.

  • Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard.

  • Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models.

  • Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required.

4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery

  • Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard.

  • Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work.

  • Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met.

  • Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate.

  • Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards.

  • Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise.

  • Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function.

5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point

  • Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers.

  • Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives.

  • Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements.

  • Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns.

  • Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals.

  • Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding.

6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN.

  • Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership.

  • Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management.

  • Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation.

  • Stay current on relevant cyber threats, attacker techniques, technologies, regulations and industry standards, and translate them into actionable priorities for KIDAN.

What Great Looks Like

  • KIDAN has a strong, credible and continuously improving cybersecurity posture. Cybersecurity is not only documented and compliant. It is genuinely strong in practice over all KIDAN.

  • KIDAN is recognized internally and externally as a credible cybersecurity partner, not simply an IT company that also sells cybersecurity. KIDAN is able to confidently demonstrate its cyber maturity to enterprise customers.

  • Our cybersecurity offering is relevant, technically strong, differentiated and commercially valuable.

  • Our SOC and cybersecurity services are delivered consistently, professionally and to a high standard. All are continuously challenged and improved.

  • KIDAN's cybersecurity revenue grows because customers trust our expertise and see clear value in our offering.

  • Enterprise customers know they have a senior, credible cybersecurity expert they can trust and escalate to.

  • Cyber risks, incidents and compliance gaps are identified early and acted upon.

  • Technology and cybersecurity teams work closely together, with cybersecurity embedded into how KIDAN builds and delivers technology

Requirements

  • Strong senior experience in cybersecurity, security operations or a CISO-level role.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity strategy, governance, risk, compliance and security operations.

  • Experience managing or leading a SOC / cyber defense function.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise cybersecurity and cybersecurity service delivery.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to challenge technical and business decisions and communicate cyber risk clearly.

  • Experience with ISO 27001 and relevant cybersecurity frameworks

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • German is a strong advantage.

  • Strong commercial awareness and ability to connect cybersecurity capabilities to customer value and business growth.

  • Hands-on, credible and comfortable operating across strategy, technology, delivery and customer conversations.

data.title: Ingénieur Systèmes Senior
data.description:
À propos de KIDAN

KIDAN est une entreprise de conseil IT en forte croissance, à taille humaine et à dimension internationale, dont le siège est en Suisse. Nous accompagnons près de 1 000 clients entreprises dans leur transformation IT, avec des solutions intelligentes, sécurisées et scalables. Distributeur exclusif de ManageEngine en Suisse, nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de premier plan : Cloudflare, SentinelOne, Colortokens, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest et bien d'autres.

Chez KIDAN, nous ne résolvons pas seulement des problèmes IT, nous créons de la valeur durable pour nos clients.

Le poste

Dans le cadre de notre expansion en Suisse Romande, KIDAN recrute un Ingénieur Systèmes Senior pour renforcer ses équipes techniques. Véritable référent, vous interviendrez directement auprès de clients stratégiques pour concevoir, déployer et optimiser des architectures IT robustes et sécurisées — tout en accompagnant les équipes internes dans leur montée en compétences.

Vos responsabilités

  • Conseil & Architecture : Conseiller les clients sur leurs choix technologiques et concevoir des architectures IT adaptées à leurs enjeux métier : infrastructure, sécurité, endpoints, identité/accès, monitoring

  • Déploiement & Support : Mettre en œuvre, configurer et maintenir des plateformes IT dans les environnements clients (ITSM, gestion des endpoints, sécurité infrastructure, opérations IT).

  • Support expert (L3) : Prendre en charge les incidents complexes que les équipes L1 et L2 n'ont pas pu résoudre, identifier les causes racines et garantir un niveau de service élevé.

  • Animation technique : Animer des ateliers, des démonstrations produit et des formations utilisateurs. Vulgariser les sujets complexes auprès d'audiences techniques et non techniques.

  • Référent interne : Être l'expert de référence pour les équipes, partager les bonnes pratiques et contribuer à la veille technologique continue.

  • Collaboration : Travailler en étroite synergie avec les équipes KIDAN en Suisse et à l'international, dans un environnement multiculturel et hybride.

Requirements

Profil recherché

  • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en conseil IT, administration systèmes avancée ou support technique de niveau L3.

  • Maîtrise solide des environnements Microsoft, infrastructure (serveurs, réseaux, endpoints) et solutions de sécurité IT.

  • Expérience pratique avec les plateformes de gestion IT : ITSM, endpoint management, sécurité infrastructure.

  • Permis de conduire requis.

  • Français et Anglais courant indispensable.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication, à l'aise aussi bien avec les équipes techniques qu'avec les directions métier.

  • Autonome, orienté client, proactif, avec un vrai sens du service et de l'impact.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons

  • Des projets techniques variés et stimulants auprès de clients en Suisse Romande

  • Un investissement concret dans vos certifications et votre développement professionnel.

  • Un environnement multiculturel, collaboratif et en forte croissance, où chaque voix compte.

  • La chance de rejoindre une entreprise à taille humaine, ambitieuse, portée par des valeurs fortes : respect, éthique, excellence.

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Mechaniker oder Anlagen- und Apparatebauer mit einigen Jahren Berufserfahrung

  • Muttersprache Deutsch, gute Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachkenntnisse von Vorteil

data.title: Product Manager (m/w/d) 100%
data.description:
Im Auftrag unseres Kunden HINT AG suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) 100%

Gesundheitswesen sicher digitalisiert

Wir decken die ICT-Bedürfnisse der Schweizer Spitäler, Heime und Praxen ab, sodass sich diese voll und ganz auf ihre Arbeit konzentrieren können.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Service Management suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n Product Manager

Deine Aufgaben

Du kennst das Gesundheitswesen und weisst, was Leistungserbringer im Alltag bewegt. Du entwickelst gerne Angebote, kannst Menschen dafür gewinnen und bringst die Umsetzung voran. Bei uns verbindest du Branchenwissen mit kommerziellem Gespür und gestaltest Produkte und Services mit konkretem Kundennutzen.

  • Du bringst dein Verständnis für die Abläufe und Herausforderungen von Spitälern, Heimen und Praxen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktstrategie und unseres Portfolios ein.
  • Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und Marktpotenziale und entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Partnern passende, standardisierte und wirtschaftliche Angebote.
  • Du führst die Beteiligten zusammen, klärst Anforderungen und Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst die Entwicklung und Markteinführung unserer Produkte und Services voran.
  • Du unterstützt Sales und Account Management in Kundengesprächen, Workshops und Angebotspräsentationen. Dabei vermittelst du den fachlichen und wirtschaftlichen Nutzen unserer Leistungen überzeugend.
  • Du präsentierst unsere Angebote und relevante Digitalisierungsthemen bei Kundenveranstaltungen, Fachanlässen und in Vorträgen.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Sales und Marketing die Positionierung, Verkaufsargumente und Unterlagen für eine erfolgreiche Vermarktung.
  • Du kalkulierst Produktkosten mit den zuständigen Fachbereichen, wirkst bei Preisen und Verrechnungsmodellen mit und beurteilst die Wirtschaftlichkeit des Portfolios.
  • Du begleitest den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus von der Einführung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ablösung und lässt Rückmeldungen aus Vertrieb und Betrieb gezielt einfliessen.
  • Du stellst verständliche und aktuelle Produktinformationen im Servicekatalog und Webshop sicher und wirkst bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres standardisierten Hardware-Sortiments mit.

Dein Profil

  • Du kennst das Schweizer Gesundheitswesen aus eigener Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise direkt bei einem Leistungserbringer wie einem Spital, Heim oder Praxisverbund.
  • Du verstehst klinische, pflegerische oder administrative Abläufe und erkennst, wo digitale Lösungen im Alltag einen Mehrwert schaffen.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Business Development, Lösungsvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gesundheitswesen, ICT und Markt mit.

data.title: Senior PMO Analyst
data.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

  • The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

data.title: Head of Operation
data.description:
About nu glass

nu glass improves wireless connectivity in enclosed spaces by making glass permeable to radio frequencies using laser ablation technology. By engraving an ultra-thin pattern that remains invisible, the company preserves the insulating properties of glazing while shaping connected environments.

Your responsibilities

As the Head of Operations, you are the operational driver of our growth. You ensure the planning, execution, and optimization of all our operational activities, from logistics to project delivery, guaranteeing quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. You play a key role in deploying our technology in Switzerland and internationally, working closely with our teams and partners..

  • Oversee day-to-day operations and coordinate cross-functional workflows

  • Manage production schedules and maintain quality standards

  • Optimize operational processes to support scaling and continuous improvement

  • Leadership & Operational Strategy: Steer and optimize all operational processes (planning, logistics, support, quality, safety). Align human, technical, and material resources with strategic objectives and the project portfolio. Develop, monitor, and optimize the operations budget. Act as a Key Leader within the management team, contributing to the company's vision and growth.

  • Project Management & Execution: Monitor and supervise the execution of all projects in Switzerland. Collaborate closely with our project managers to align practices and ensure operational consistency. Participate in deployment in new markets and ensure regular, structured reporting to Project Managers and senior management.

  • Operational Excellence & Customer Support: Guarantee the quality and safety of all on-site interventions. Oversee transport logistics and the supply chain. Manage customer operations and after-sales support, ensuring an impeccable customer experience. Continuously improve processes to increase efficiency and reliability.

Requirements

  • Experience leading operational teams in a technical or manufacturing environment

  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work on-site in Nyon and remotely in a hybrid setup

  • Higher education (Master's/Engineering degree) in operations management, logistics, project management, or a technical field

  • Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in a similar role as Head of Operations, Senior Project Manager, or Logistics Manager, ideally in an industrial, technological, or high-end services environment

  • Must speak German and English fluently, French is a plus.

  • Proven experience in team management and managing complex projects

  • Excellent command of planning and budget control

  • Mobility: Willing to travel occasionally in Europe (and potentially beyond) for projects or meetings

Skills

  • Advanced expertise in operational and supply chain processes

  • Strong budget management, financial tracking, and forecasting skills

  • Proficient in advanced project management and resource scheduling techniques

  • Inspiring leadership with the ability to unite and motivate teams

  • Excellent organizational skills, rigor, and pragmatism

  • High adaptability and proactive approach in a fast-evolving scale-up environment

  • Exceptional communicator, capable of collaborating with technical teams, sales teams, and demanding clients

  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset

Your first months at nu glass

You will take ownership of existing operational workflows, align manufacturing schedules with technical requirements, and establish close collaboration with the team on-site in Nyon. Within your first months, you will have streamlined daily processes and gained a complete overview of laser ablation production.

Benefits

Flexible working hours support your schedule. Travel expenses compensation covers your commutes. Home office and remote work options provide flexibility between the Nyon HeadQuarter, home and customer sites. Free beverages are available on-site. A company cellphone and a company laptop are provided for your work.

Compensation

CHF 90,000–120,000 per year

data.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
data.description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Doctolib Connect team in Amsterdam.

Doctolib Connect is a secure medical communication app designed for healthcare professionals. More than 1M healthcare professionals use Doctolib Connect to discuss and coordinate patient care with colleagues, both within and beyond their organizational walls. Today, Doctolib Connect is the largest medical network in Europe. You'll work closely with a talented team to develop user-friendly products that meet market demands, such as tele-expertise or patient referral flows.

What you'll do

As a Senior Product Manager on the Doctolib Connect team, you will drive the development of products that strengthen care cooperation among healthcare professionals. Working at the heart of a cross-functional team, you will shape products that serve over 900,000 users across our network, combining a user-centric and data-driven approach with a focus on network effects and long-term impact. Success in this role means growing Doctolib Connect's network, launching products that achieve product-market fit, and delivering measurable value for both our users and the business.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Contributing to our product strategy to grow Doctolib Connect, identifying opportunities that strengthen the network and deliver user and business value

  • Defining, shipping, and iterating on new products and features by analysing data, conducting user interviews, researching competitors, and leveraging cross-functional insights

  • Continuously measuring adoption, impact, and network health, iterating as needed to achieve desired outcomes for your product and company goals

  • Collaborating with engineering, design, and research teams to translate insights into hypotheses, experiments, and features that delight users and grow Doctolib Connect's network

  • Working closely with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, support, and company leadership to ensure solutions serve users and meet business needs across target markets

Who you are

Are you convinced that you have exactly what it takes for the position? Then we encourage you to apply. Even if you don't meet every requirement, you might be exactly the right future Doctoliber for this or other positions!

You could be our next team mate if you:

  • Have 4+ years of Product Management experience, including at least 1 year working on mobile applications, with a track record of shipping products that have delivered meaningful business results and proven user value

  • Have experience developing SaaS or mobile products, ideally including a network effect component such as social networking, communication services, or collaborative workplace tools

  • Approach problems with an analytical mindset, balancing quantitative and qualitative insights to make data-informed decisions

  • Communicate with clarity and conviction to align diverse stakeholders, both technical and non-technical, driving vision and articulating user value and business impact

  • Are highly organised and disciplined in project management, with strong attention to detail and the confidence to ask tough questions and say no when needed


Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with health tech, marketplace, or platform products

  • Are familiar with operating in multi-market environments

  • Have worked in a scale-up or fast-paced product organisation

Our AI vision

We believe in the responsible use of AI to improve healthcare. Find out more about our approach here.

What we offer:

  • Company pension scheme through our partner Allianz

  • 27 days of annual leave per year (and the ability to accrue more days on your work anniversary!)

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

data.title: Senior Social & AI Marketeer
data.description:
Jouw impact als Senior Social & AI Marketeer

Als Senior Social & AI Marketeer bij Indicia ben je het strategische aanspreekpunt voor grote klanten en vertaal je hun commerciële doelstellingen naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën. Je combineert strategisch advies met een hands-on aanpak en ontwikkelt en optimaliseert campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok. Daarbij werk je met grote mediabudgetten en krijg je volop ruimte om impact te maken. AI speelt een belangrijke rol in jouw werk. Je benut slimme tools en automatisering om campagnes, content en processen continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast signaleer je proactief commerciële kansen bij klanten en deel je jouw kennis en ervaring met junior marketeers. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan het succes van klanten, maar ook aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team en de dienstverlening van Indicia.

Over Indicia

Indicia is een onafhankelijk tech, data en AI-bureau dat sinds 1996 organisaties helpt om digitaal te groeien. Vanuit de overtuiging dat succesvolle digitale oplossingen beginnen bij een goed begrip van de business, combineert Indicia technologie, data en ondernemerschap om organisaties verder te brengen.

Met ruim 250 digitale specialisten biedt Indicia een breed scala aan diensten, waaronder online marketing, webdevelopment, HubSpot, AI en design. Van het ontwikkelen van websites en digitale platforms tot het realiseren van effectieve marketingcampagnes en slimme automatiseringen. Indicia bedient klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en richt zich steeds meer op grotere organisaties en langdurige samenwerkingen.

De organisatie bevindt zich in een fase van verdere professionalisering, waarbij de focus ligt op het verdiepen van specialismen, het versterken van de strategische klantrelaties en het realiseren van meetbare resultaten. AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Indicia ontwikkelt eigen AI-tools om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten, waardoor meer ruimte ontstaat voor strategisch advies, innovatie en klantontwikkeling.

De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, familiair en ondernemend. Collega's werken nauw samen, krijgen veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en worden gestimuleerd om zich zowel persoonlijk als professioneel te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd groeit de ambitie om resultaatgerichter te werken en als organisatie verder te professionaliseren.

https://www.indicia.ai/

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Ontwikkelen en presenteren van socialmediastrategieën voor grote klanten, waarbij je commerciële doelstellingen vertaalt naar concrete campagnes en meetbare resultaten;
  • Actief bijdragen aan commerciële voorstellen, pitches en pre-salesgesprekken, waarbij je klanten adviseert over de mogelijkheden van social advertising;
  • Fungeren als strategisch en inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, waarbij je periodiek campagneresultaten presenteert en proactief kansen voor upsell en cross-sell signaleert;
  • Zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van paid social campagnes op platforms als Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok, inclusief het bewaken van instellingen, KPI's en budgetten;
  • Analyseren van campagneresultaten, uitvoeren van A/B-testen en continu verbeteren van performance, conversies en rendement;
  • Samenwerken met het interne AI-lab om AI en automatisering slim toe te passen binnen campagnes, contentcreatie, budgetoptimalisatie en werkprocessen;
  • Signaleren en toepassen van nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen social advertising en AI, waarbij je ook de verbinding legt met andere online marketingdisciplines, zoals SEO en SEA;
  • Coachen en begeleiden van junior social marketeers, kennis delen en bijdragen aan hun professionele ontwikkeling;
  • Aanbrengen van structuur, stimuleren van eigenaarschap en bewaken van de kwaliteit binnen het social team.

Jouw plek binnen de organisatie:

Als ervaren collega ben je een vraagbaak en sparringpartner voor de junior social marketeers. Je deelt je kennis over social en AI, en helpt hen zo verder te groeien. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Sophie Mees, Delivery Manager Online Marketing.

Requirements

Je bent een enthousiaste en ondernemende persoonlijkheid die energie brengt, initiatief neemt en het team weet mee te nemen in nieuwe ideeën. Je voelt je thuis in een informele en familiaire werkomgeving en draagt met jouw commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het team.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met paid social advertising, bij voorkeur binnen een groter marketingbureau, waarbij je gewend bent te werken met aanzienlijke mediabudgetten;
  • Uitgebreide kennis van advertentieplatforms zoals Meta, LinkedIn en TikTok en ervaring met het zelfstandig opzetten, beheren en optimaliseren van campagnes;
  • Een analytische instelling en aantoonbare ervaring met campagneanalyse, A/B-testen en performanceoptimalisatie;
  • Een sterke strategische en commerciële blik, waarbij je businessdoelstellingen vertaalt naar effectieve socialmediastrategieën en kansen voor klantgroei signaleert;
  • Ervaring als strategisch gesprekspartner voor klanten op management- en directieniveau, gecombineerd met sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardigheden;
  • Een AI-minded en tech-savvy instelling, waarbij je AI actief inzet voor contentontwikkeling, campagneoptimalisatie en het automatiseren van werkprocessen;
  • Ervaring met het coachen en begeleiden van junior collega's en het delen van vakinhoudelijke kennis; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Benefits

Bij Indicia kom je terecht in een informele en ambitieuze werkomgeving waar je de vrijheid krijgt om initiatief te nemen en écht impact te maken. Je werkt voor aansprekende klanten, krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-tools en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening.

  • Een passend salaris;
  • Een dienstverband van 32 tot 40 uur per week;
  • 25 vakantiedagen, aangevuld met extra vrije dagen voor gezamenlijke bedrijfsactiviteiten;
  • Arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Pensioenregeling 100% bijdrage door werkgever;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding voor zowel auto als openbaar vervoer;
  • Laptop van de zaak (MacBook of Windows);
  • Dagelijks lunch, regelmatig leuke borrels, en de (buitenlands) bedrijfstrip!



Contact

René de Boer

Jij zorgt dat de expertise van Movares niet alleen wordt gezien, maar ook leidt tot een sterkere marktpositie, hechtere klantrelaties en nieuwe opdrachten.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

Je houdt regie op de marketingcommunicatieaanpak en het resultaat, waarbij je de specialistische uitvoering bij collega's en externe partners legt.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een stevige en resultaatgerichte adviseur die snel tot de kern komt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen directie, inhoudelijke experts en uitvoerende partners, brengt focus in uiteenlopende belangen en durft richting te geven. Daarbij combineer je strategisch inzicht met commerciële scherpte en daadkracht.

Dit breng je ook mee: 

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in marketing of marketingcommunicatie;

  • ruime ervaring in een strategische marketing-communicatierol. Bij voorkeur in een zakelijke of kennisintensieve B2B-omgeving;

  • aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van directies en businessverantwoordelijken en het vertalen van organisatiedoelstellingen naar een resultaatgerichte marketingcommunicatieaanpak;

  • ervaring met het coördineren van multidisciplinaire werkzaamheden en het projectmatig aansturen van interne specialisten en externe partners.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. 

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 6.500 en € 7.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen.

data.title: Senior adviseur EMC
data.description:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jouw advies voorkomt dat hoogspanningsverbindingen risico’s voor de omgeving veroorzaken. Zo maak jij de uitbreiding van het Nederlandse energienet veilig en verantwoord mogelijk.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je adviseert toonaangevende opdrachtgevers over complexe elektromagnetische beïnvloeding rond hoogspanningsverbindingen.

  • Je vertaalt normen en technische analyses naar heldere scenario’s, risico’s en praktisch uitvoerbare maatregelen.

  • Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise zichtbaar in te zetten, bijvoorbeeld bij klanten en binnen normcommissies.

Als senior adviseur EMC overzie je complexe vraagstukken rond elektromagnetische beïnvloeding. Je beoordeelt welke normen van toepassing zijn, doorziet vroegtijdig de gevolgen voor assets van derden en adviseert over passende maatregelen. Je kijkt verder dan afzonderlijke berekeningen, waarbij je project overstijgende risico’s signaleert, de scope afbakent en klanten helpt weloverwogen keuzes te maken. Je werkt voor onder meer netbeheerders, infrabeheerders en eigenaren van kabels en leidingen.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met overtuigende adviesvaardigheden. Je bent klantgericht, pragmatisch en oplossingsgericht en weet complexe normering begrijpelijk uit te leggen zonder de technische nauwkeurigheid te verliezen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je projecten, zoekt actief de samenwerking op en durft richting te geven aan klanten en collega’s.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in elektrotechniek, technische natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting;

  • ruime relevante werkervaring, bij voorkeur circa tien jaar, met EMC, elektromagnetische beïnvloeding, hoogspanningssystemen of een aanverwant specialistisch vakgebied;

  • ervaring met technisch advies, projectmatig werken en het vertalen van normen en onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete maatregelen;

  • ervaring met GIS applicaties en programmeren in MATLAB of Python is een pré;

  • kennis van de NEN3654:2023 en RLN00398 is een pré.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen €6.250 en €7.250 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

De afdeling Energie is een gezellige en sociale club van ongeveer 50 collega’s. Regelmatig organiseren we gezellige teamuitjes, organiseren we uitdagende kennissessies en zijn we aanwezig op leerzame events! Als onderdeel van team Energie sta je midden in de energietransitie. Samen met je collega’s benader je deze enorme uitdaging procesmatig en vanuit de inhoud. Door een zeer professionele way of working kom je met elkaar tot creatieve en toekomstbestendige adviezen én ontwerpen die we aanbieden aan opdrachtgevers als TenneT, Stedin, ProRail, Provincies, Ministeries en Rijkswaterstaat. De afdeling Energie focust zich op duurzame energievoorziening, rail energiesystemen en EMC & netkwaliteit.

Movares is zeer ervaren en groot genoeg om succesvol te zijn in de meest uitdagende projecten van het land. Deze uitdagingen ga jij vanuit afdeling Energie aan binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen. Jij en je collega’s zijn zeer betrokken bij het werk. Samen met hen voer jij projecten uit in het werkveld Energie, voor ‘onze’ opdrachtgevers. Daarnaast werk je met teams van andere afdelingen samen aan multidisciplinaire projecten. Zo proef je verschillende werkvelden en leer je van adviseurs en engineers in meerdere disciplines. Jouw ontwikkeling gaat altijd door!

data.title: Backend Software Developer
data.description:
Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions).

  • Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

  • Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging.

  • Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden.

  • Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper).

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

data.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
data.description:
Who we are

We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.

 

We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands.

We’re on the search for...

Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it.

In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other.

The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp.

This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.

 

What you’ll be doing

You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline.

The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.
